title: NextJS Full Stack Developer
descriptionText:
NextJS Full Stack Developer

*Company: Quantum Realm Engineering*

*Industry:* IT

*Work format:* Remote

*Employment type:* Full-time

*Experience required:* More than 1 year

*English level:* Advanced

*Key Skills*

* SQL
* Git
* Docker
* TypeScript
* Database work
* Front-end development
* Backend development
* Tailwind CSS
* *Dependency injection*
* SOLID principles
* CI/CD
* React Query
* Vercel*Job Description*

We are looking for a strong Next.js Full Stack Developer to join an Australian software development company working directly with customers on start-ups and existing enterprise applications.

You will work across both front-end and back-end development, with some AI-related implementation where required. You will join an existing team and help build new features, improve existing products and support live applications.

*Skills and Experience*

The ideal candidate should have:

* At least 2+ years of commercial experience with Next.js, TypeScript and React
* Strong knowledge of the React stack, including React, Tailwind CSS, React Query and Zod
* Deep full stack Next.js experience, including both client-side and server-side implementation
* The ability to build well-structured applications that handle state, validation and errors properly
* Strong SQL knowledge
* The ability to write type-safe and reliable code
* Experience using type checkers and commit hooks
* LLM API integration experience
* Proficiency with Git for version control
* Understanding of GOF patterns, SOLID principles, dependency injection and clean architecture
* Good documentation habits
* Experience with Linux, Bash and Docker
* Experience with CI/CD tools for automatic deployment
* Vercel experience, including best practices for background processing and common live application issues
* AWS or GCP experience, including the ability to deploy and maintain backends, queues and databases
* Knowledge of when to use VMs, serverless functions and other cloud services
* Conversational English, with the ability to explain thoughts clearly and write clean documentation

*Apply If You Are*

* Proactive and detail-oriented
* Comfortable working on new products and existing systems
* Someone who fixes problems when you see them
* Someone with an automation mindset
* Someone who documents things clearly rather than relying on memory
* Ready for occasional early starts or late finishes to join Sydney-time customer calls when needed

*Additional Experience That Would Be a Plus*

* Python, FastAPI and SQLAlchemy experience
* LangChain, LLM prompting or machine learning experience
* Experience writing tests
* Interest in investing or previous fintech experience
* A strong GitHub profile

*Benefits*

* Paid in USD
* Flexible hours

title: Software Engineer
descriptionText:
*About the Role*

As a Software Engineer, you will primarily work on Java backend services, with opportunities to contribute to Android, iOS, and web applications for our client. This role spans three key areas: Development, Operations, and Innovation which will give you broad exposure to building, maintaining, and evolving our client's products. You will report to the Senior Software Engineer and collaborate with developers, tech leads, and support staff across Australia, UK, USA, and Indonesia.

Our client is RealThing AI – an Australian Artificial Intelligence company with operations in USA and UK. RealThing AI develops cutting-edge dialogue and reasoning solutions, with their flagship product RealSAM serving the Visually Impaired community since 2017. They sell directly to major customers in the US and direct to consumers in the UK.

*What You'll Do*

* Develop, operate, and maintain Java backend services powering the RealSAM platform which is our client's flagship product for the visually impaired market
* Contribute to Android, iOS, and web application development as needed
* Provide technical support to the test and customer support teams
* Collaborate with international teams across multiple time zones through virtual meetings, chat, and email
* Contribute to the implementation of robust, maintainable code and software infrastructure
* Participate in Agile development processes including code reviews, branching, and release management
* Work across Development, Operations, and Innovation teams to support product delivery and next-generation product development

*What We're Looking For*

*Required*

* University-level qualification in Computing or Engineering
* A high level of proficiency and demonstrated experience involving the development, operation, and maintenance of software in Java
* A high level of proficiency and demonstrated experience in all aspects of the software development process including code compilation, packaging, deployment, release methodology, and application configuration
* Excellent skills and knowledge of Linux environment
* Experience branching and merging ideally with Git
* Experience with Agile software development projects
* Good English communication skills both spoken and written
* Ability to work independently with initiative, efficiency, and accuracy while maintaining a professional manner
* Work co-operatively, supportively, and effectively within the team
* Accountability for the achievement of responsibilities established for the position
* Contribute to the implementation of robust and maintainable code and software infrastructure

*Preferred*

* Experience in AI, LLMs, Intelligent Software Agents, and AI-driven spec-based development
* Experience in creating systems that provide an accessible user experience for people with vision impairment
* Experience in voice-controlled applications, including those for commercial smart speakers, Google Home, and Amazon Echo
* Experience in Android and/or iOS development
* Experience with web development
* Experience with creation, operation, and maintenance of scalable cloud-based systems
* Experience in AWS cloud infrastructure including familiarity with TCP/IP networking, SSH, and SSL/HTTPS
* Experience in scripting (Bash, Zsh), SQL, XML, REST, and JSON
* Experience with content catalogues and Solr

*Benefits*

* Remote work – work from anywhere in Bali
* Health insurance (BPJS Kesehatan)
* Employment social security (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan)
* Annual religious holiday allowance

Job Type: Full-time



Application Question(s):
* What is your English proficiency level in terms of Speaking (Beginner, Pre-Intermediate, Intermediate, Upper Intermediate, Advanced)?
* What is your English proficiency level in terms of Writing (Beginner, Pre-Intermediate, Intermediate, Upper Intermediate, Advanced)?

Location:
* Denpasar (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Denpasar

title: UX/UI Designer
descriptionText:
*UX/UI DesignerWebsites, Apps, Pitch Decks and Digital Brand Assets*

*Company:* Quantum Realm Engineering

*Industry:* IT, software development, AI, design and digital products

*Company size:* 10–50 employees

*Work format:* Remote

*Employment type:* Full-time

*Experience required:* More than 2 years

*English level:* Advanced

*Key Skills*

* UX design
* UI design
* Figma
* Wireframing
* Website design
* Web app design
* Mobile app design
* Pitch deck design
* PowerPoint design
* Brand asset design
* Brochure design
* Presentation design
* Design systems
* Responsive design
* User flows
* Prototyping
* Client-facing design
* Layout design
* Visual hierarchy
* Typography
* Design handover
* Attention to detail

*Job Description*

Quantum Realm Engineering is looking for a UX/UI Designer to help create websites, apps, dashboards, pitch decks, brochures and client-facing digital assets.

We are an Australian software, AI and digital product company working with start-ups, founders and growing businesses. Our work includes websites, web apps, mobile apps, AI systems, internal dashboards, customer portals, sales decks, brand refreshes and digital product concepts.

This role is suited to a designer who can think clearly, work fast, organise information properly and turn rough ideas into polished designs that clients can understand and use.

You will work closely with project managers, developers, marketers and company leadership to design digital products and supporting business material.

*Role Focus*

This role includes design work across:

* Website designs and redesigns
* Landing pages
* Web apps and dashboards
* Mobile apps
* UX wireframes
* User flows
* Clickable prototypes
* Pitch decks
* Sales presentations
* Investor decks
* Company profiles
* Service brochures
* Capability decks
* Social media assets
* Brand refresh concepts
* Design systems and reusable components
* Client proposal visuals
* Product mock-ups
* Developer handover files

*Key Responsibilities*

The successful candidate will be responsible for turning business, product and content requirements into clean, usable designs.

*UX and Wireframing*

Create user flows, page structures, wireframes and early product layouts.

Think through how users move through websites, apps, dashboards and portals before visual design begins.

*Website and Landing Page Design*

Design modern websites and landing pages for software, AI, business, hospitality, property, finance and service-based clients.

Make sure pages are easy to scan, commercially clear and structured for conversion.

*App and Product Design*

Design web app and mobile app screens for products such as dashboards, portals, AI tools, booking systems, internal business tools and customer-facing platforms.

Create layouts that are practical for developers to build.

*Pitch Deck and Presentation Design*

Design pitch decks, proposals, client presentations, investor decks and sales decks in Figma or PowerPoint.

Make dense content easier to understand through layout, spacing, visual hierarchy and better page structure.

*Brochures and Brand Assets*

Design company profiles, brochures, one-pagers, capability documents and branded client-facing material.

Keep designs consistent with each client’s tone, brand and commercial objective.

*Figma Design Systems*

Create organised Figma files with proper sections, components, naming, spacing and reusable elements.

Keep files clean enough for other designers, developers and project managers to use without confusion.

*Developer Handover*

Prepare designs so developers can build them properly.

This includes layout notes, component states, spacing logic, responsive behaviour and clear export-ready assets.

*Client Revisions*

Apply feedback carefully and improve designs without losing the original purpose of the project.

The role requires someone who can take feedback without becoming defensive.

*Required Experience and Skills*

The ideal candidate should have:

* At least 2+ years of UX/UI design experience
* Strong experience with Figma
* Experience designing websites, landing pages and digital products
* Experience designing web app or mobile app interfaces
* Good understanding of responsive design
* Ability to create wireframes, user flows and clickable prototypes
* Strong layout, typography and spacing skills
* Experience designing pitch decks, brochures or presentation material
* Ability to turn rough copy or notes into structured visual layouts
* Good understanding of how design supports sales, trust and usability
* Ability to work with developers and prepare clean handover files
* Strong attention to detail
* Good English communication skills
* Ability to work remotely and manage design tasks without constant supervision
* Good file organisation habits

*Apply If You Are*

* Strong in Figma
* Comfortable designing both websites and apps
* Good at making complex information easier to understand
* Able to design pitch decks and presentation material
* Detail-oriented with spacing, alignment and typography
* Practical in how you design for developers
* Comfortable working across multiple client brands
* Able to move quickly without making messy work
* Good at taking feedback and improving the design
* Organised with files, components and naming
* Comfortable working with a remote team

*This Role Is Not For You If*

* You only want to do brand identity work
* You do not want to work on websites, apps or dashboards
* You dislike PowerPoint or presentation design
* You struggle to organise Figma files properly
* You need every detail explained before starting
* You ignore spacing, alignment or mobile responsiveness
* You design screens that look good but are hard to build
* You are uncomfortable with client feedback
* You miss small details in text, layout or consistency

*Additional Experience That Would Be a Plus*

* Experience with PowerPoint deck design
* Experience with Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop or InDesign
* Experience with Canva
* Experience designing for software, AI, fintech or SaaS products
* Experience designing dashboards, portals or admin panels
* Experience creating design systems
* Experience with basic motion or micro-interaction concepts
* Experience preparing social media assets
* Experience with Webflow, WordPress or Framer
* Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, Tailwind CSS or front-end development
* Portfolio showing websites, apps, decks and brochure-style work

*Portfolio Requirements*

Please include a portfolio showing examples of:

* Website designs
* App or dashboard screens
* Wireframes or UX flows
* Pitch decks or presentation designs
* Brochures, company profiles or similar business documents
* Any before-and-after redesign work

*Benefits*

* Remote work
* Flexible working hours
* Work with an Australian software, AI and digital product company
* Variety across websites, apps, decks, brochures and client brands
* Direct collaboration with developers and project managers
* Work on real client projects rather than only internal concepts
* Opportunity to grow into a senior product design or creative lead role



Application Question(s):
* Do you reside in Indonesia? 

Language:
* English (Required)

Location:
* Bali (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

descriptionText:

Familiar menggunakan tools seperti Jira, Postman, atau tools testing lainnya.
Memiliki kemampuan analisa dan problem solving yang baik.
Teliti, komunikatif, dan mampu bekerja secara individu maupun tim.

title: Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure & Acquisition - Jakarta, Indonesia
descriptionText:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

We're looking to hire for our Data side of our AI team at Speechify. This role is responsible for all aspects of data collection to support our model training operations. We are able to build high-quality datasets at petabyte-scale and low cost through a tight integration of infrastructure, engineering, and research work. We are looking for a skilled Software Engineer to join us.

What You'll Do

Be scrappy to find new sources of audio data and bring it into our ingestion pipeline
Operate and extend the cloud infrastructure for our ingestion pipeline, currently running on GCP and managed with Terraform.
Collaborate closely with our Scientists to shift the cost/throughput/quality frontier, delivering richer data at bigger scale and lower cost to power our next-generation models.
Collaborate with others on the AI Team and Speechify Leadership to craft the AI Team's dataset roadmap to power Speechify's next-generation consumer and enterprise products.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or a related field.
5+ years of industry experience in software development.
Proficiency with bash/Python scripting in Linux environments
Proficiency in Docker and Infrastructure-as-Code concepts and professional experience with at least one major Cloud Provider (we use GCP)
Experience with web crawlers, large-scale data processing workflows is a plus
Ability to handle multiple tasks and adapt to changing priorities.
Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.

What we offer

A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, and hustle.
A hands-off management approach so you can focus and do your best work.
An opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry.
Competitive salaries, a friendly and laid-back atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture.
Opportunity to work on a life-changing product that millions of people use.
Build products that directly impact and support people with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, low vision, concussions, autism, and more.
Work in one of the fastest-growing sectors of tech, the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio.

Think you're a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Drafter
descriptionText:
*INITIA Group is looking for a Drafter – Indonesia!*

*Job Title:* Drafter (Architecture / Interior / Fit-Out)

*Job Level:* Junior to Mid-Level

*Salary: IDR 7,000,000 – 10,000,000*

*Department:* Project Operations Department

*Location:* Jakarta, Indonesia

*Work Schedule:* *TBD*

*Overall Job Objectives*

INITIA Group is seeking a detail-oriented and technically skilled *Drafter* to support our Project Operations team in developing accurate technical drawings for F&B, Wellness, and retail outlet construction and renovation projects in Indonesia.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for producing detailed architectural, interior, and technical drawings to support the execution of store fit-out, renovation, and new outlet development projects. This role requires strong technical accuracy, understanding of construction detailing, and the ability to coordinate closely with project managers, designers, and contractors.

*Core Responsibilities*

* Prepare detailed 2D and 3D drawings for architectural, interior, and fit-out projects
* Convert design concepts into accurate technical drawings for construction and renovation works
* Revise and update drawings based on feedback from project managers, designers, and site conditions
* Ensure all drawings comply with project specifications, design intent, and construction requirements
* Coordinate with Project Managers, Designers, and Contractors to ensure drawing accuracy and execution feasibility
* Prepare shop drawings, as-built drawings, and layout plans for site implementation
* Assist in preparing material specifications and technical documentation
* Maintain proper documentation and version control of all drawings and design files
* Support site teams by providing technical clarification when required
* Ensure timely delivery of all drafting outputs based on project schedules

*Job Specifications*

* Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Interior Design, Civil Engineering, or related field
* Minimum *1–3 years of experience* as a Drafter in construction, interior fit-out, retail, or F&B projects
* Proficient in *AutoCAD* (mandatory)
* Knowledge of *SketchUp, 3D rendering software, or Revit* is an advantage
* Strong understanding of construction detailing, materials, and technical specifications
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and interior design drawings
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Able to work under tight deadlines and manage multiple revisions
* Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with project teams
* Professional proficiency in *Bahasa Indonesia*; English is an advantage

*Key Deliverables*

* Accurate and timely production of construction and shop drawings
* Updated drawing revisions based on project requirements
* Complete and well-organized drawing documentation for each project
* Support for smooth project execution through precise technical detailing
* Compliance with project design standards and construction requirements
* Effective coordination with project and site teams

*Benefits of the Role*

* Competitive monthly salary package
* THR (Religious Holiday Allowance) in accordance with Indonesian labor law
* BPJS Kesehatan and BPJS Ketenagakerjaan
* Annual leave entitlement
* Medical benefits
* Performance-based project incentives (if applicable)
* Staff discounts across INITIA Group brands
* Career growth opportunities within a regional hospitality and development group
* Exposure to premium F&B and wellness project developments
* Collaborative and creative working environment

*INITIA GROUP *is the biggest brand concept leader in Singapore & Malaysia. We have been in the beauty and F&B industry for years and are now in Art, Retail, and Photo Studios. We are a fast-paced growing company, bringing all unique and on-trend concepts. We have a lot of expansions going on and we need additional talents in our growing family.

If you’re excited about our company’s vision for this position and want to start the path of becoming one of our future leaders, we’d like to hear from you.

You may visit our website to learn more about us:

*APPLY NOW! *

*About Company*

SalesDoc is a pre-Seed Data & AI startup, founded by former specialists from Microsoft, Google. Using our proprietary “Asia-Intent” Data Engine platform, we empower business and connect them with ready-to-buy clients across Asia by uplifting meetings by 50% over standard outreach methods.

Our core values are 1) Customer Centricity and 2) Employees grow before the Company grow (clearly defined career path & promotion timeline due to our promote from within culture). We pride ourselves on our diverse and inclusive work culture, where every team member is valued and respected.

*Why Join Us*

· You’ll get to work with advanced AI models, unique Data sets and leverage them to create software solutions with real-world impact, taking full ownership of the platform end-to-end. This role is for engineers who want to create, experiment, and innovate, getting real feedback on AI products you will launch along the way. You’ll be part of a team that values builders, people who make things happen, not just climb the ladder.

· We have a strong bias for ambitious candidates who are determined to learn, grow, and go the extra mile to invest in their own career development. You’ll deepen your technical expertise and expand your impact as the company scales to manage cross functional engineering teams.

*Role Overview:*

* As a Tech Lead/Full stack engineer, you’ll be responsible for leading the end-to-end development of full-stack applications while ensuring robust, scalable platform infrastructure. You’ll combine hands-on coding with platform engineering expertise, overseeing CI/CD pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and system reliability. This role requires a deep understanding of both application development and DevOps best practices, with a focus on delivering high-quality, production-ready solutions.

*Key Responsibilities: *

* Own and lead the overall design, development, and deployment of full-stack web applications and APIs.
* Architect and manage cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure), focusing on scalability, security, and cost-efficiency.
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable releases.
* Optimize platform performance, reliability, and observability (monitoring, logging, alerting).
* Collaborate with product and business teams to deliver features and platform improvements.
* Mentor junior engineers and promote best practices in code quality, testing, and security.
* Evaluate and adopt new technologies to improve engineering efficiency and product quality.
* Troubleshoot technical and platform-related issues, ensuring smooth operations.

*Mandatory Requirements: *

* 6 years of hands-on software engineering and Tech Lead experience. Fluent use of AI coding tools (Antigravity, Claude Code, CODEX etc.) is mandatory.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, Python, React Libraries, or similar.
* Experience with DevOps tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.).
* Knowledge of one or more of these cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Excellent and concise communication skills.
* Agile and collaborative, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, ever-changing environments.
* Proven track record of shipping and maintaining production applications.

*Preferred requirements:*

* Exposure with MLOps or machine learning infrastructure.
* Exposure to SaaS or B2B tech products.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).
* Knowledge of security best practices and compliance frameworks (PDPA, privacy laws).

We’re on the lookout for one brilliant mind to join us. If you love building cool stuff and seeing it work in the real world, don’t wait any longer and *apply now!*

descriptionText:
What we're looking for

We are seeking a talented, endlessly curious individual to join our team. You’ll be working closely with our group of companies in the fintech sector as part of the Engineering department. This company is a leading B2B fintech platform in its field, processing over US$2B across multiple currencies annually. We’re looking for individuals who are driven to create meaningful value, take full ownership of what they build, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you’re motivated by impactful work and eager to be part of an innovative team, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Go, with a strong emphasis on code quality and maintainability

Integrate with third-party payment services (e.g. banks, e-wallets) and handle edge cases such as ambiguous or delayed responses

Write robust unit and integration tests for all new features and ensure proper validation for critical payment flows

Collaborate cross-functionally with product, infra, and QA teams to define, design, and ship high-impact features

Guide and mentor junior and mid-level engineers, providing technical leadership through code reviews, design discussions and pairing sessions

Lead by example in enforcing clean architecture, clear documentation, and reliable observability practices

Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, improve system resilience, and optimize for correctness and traceability

Stay up to date with emerging technologies and propose improvements aligned with business goals

Build software with security and compliance in mind, ensuring proper access control, logging, and auditing

Deploy applications to AWS infrastructure and support operational readiness of services

What you should have

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a relevant field

5+ years of backend engineering experience, with production-level experience in Go

Proven track record of integrating with external APIs, especially in payment, banking, or financial services

Strong foundation in system design, test-driven development, and writing maintainable, well-documented code

Comfortable working with PostgreSQL and Redis in high-availability environment

Experience with test automation and methodologies for both unit and integration testing

Strong communication skills - able to explain trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Familiarity with Agile practices and a commitment to continuous improvement

Security-conscious mindset; familiarity with OWASP vulnerabilities and mitigation techniques

Demonstrated leadership in team settings - mentoring, reviewing and leveling up peers

Excellent communication and documentation skills in English.

About Us

Xenith is a B2B payment service provider focused on enabling seamless cross-border commerce. With an MSB license in Canada and PJP III license in Indonesia, we offer global merchants a one-stop solution to manage multi-currency payments - with a strong focus on alternative payment methods in emerging markets. Our deep regional expertise and strong partnerships with top local gateways, we simplify the complexity of fragmented payment landscapes, helping global merchants expand faster and more efficiently. At Xenith, we believe in building a culture where people feel empowered, trusted, and challenged to do their best work. Join us as we build the financial infrastructure of tomorrow!

title: Surveyor Konstruksi – Proyek Pabrik & Gedung Perkantoran
descriptionText:
*Lokasi:* Bogor, Jawa Barat

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Kami mencari *Surveyor Konstruksi* yang berpengalaman dan teliti untuk bergabung dalam tim proyek pembangunan pabrik, gudang, dan gedung perkantoran di wilayah Bogor. Kandidat yang terpilih akan bertanggung jawab atas seluruh pekerjaan survei dan setting out, khususnya untuk pekerjaan pondasi dan struktur bangunan, guna memastikan pelaksanaan konstruksi sesuai dengan gambar kerja dan spesifikasi yang telah disetujui.

Tanggung Jawab

* Melakukan survei lapangan dan menentukan titik kontrol proyek (benchmark dan control point).
* Melakukan setting out untuk pekerjaan pondasi, pile cap, kolom, grid line, jalan, saluran drainase, dan struktur bangunan.
* Memastikan dimensi, elevasi, koordinat, dan posisi konstruksi sesuai dengan gambar kerja.
* Menyiapkan laporan hasil survei, data pengukuran, dan gambar as-built.
* Berkoordinasi dengan Project Manager, Site Engineer, Konsultan, dan Kontraktor.
* Memastikan seluruh pekerjaan survei memenuhi standar mutu dan spesifikasi proyek.
* Mengoperasikan dan memelihara peralatan survei seperti Total Station, Auto Level, GPS, dan peralatan terkait lainnya.
* Melakukan pengecekan dan monitoring pekerjaan konstruksi selama pelaksanaan proyek.

Kualifikasi

* Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Sipil, Geodesi, Geomatika, atau bidang terkait.
* Memiliki pengalaman minimal *5 tahun* sebagai Surveyor pada proyek konstruksi gedung.
* Berpengalaman dalam *setting out pondasi untuk pabrik, gudang, dan gedung perkantoran*.
* Menguasai penggunaan *Total Station, GPS, Auto Level, AutoCAD*, dan software survei lainnya.
* Memahami gambar kerja, koordinat, elevasi, dan layout struktur bangunan.
* Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik dan bertanggung jawab terhadap pekerjaan.
* Bersedia ditempatkan dan bekerja penuh waktu di *Bogor*.

Kualifikasi Tambahan (Nilai Plus)

* Berpengalaman dalam proyek konstruksi industri dan komersial.
* Memahami standar dan regulasi konstruksi yang berlaku di Indonesia.
* Mampu membuat dan memverifikasi dokumen as-built drawing.

Fasilitas

* Gaji kompetitif sesuai pengalaman dan kualifikasi.
* Kesempatan bekerja pada proyek industri dan komersial berskala besar.
* Peluang pengembangan karier dan peningkatan kompetensi profesional.

*Cara Melamar:*

Kirimkan CV terbaru, ekspektasi gaji, serta daftar pengalaman proyek yang relevan melalui Indeed atau email perusahaan.

descriptionText:
About SMS Perkasa

We're an innovative steel and building materials distributor based in Surabaya, transforming how the industry operates through technology. While others in the steel trade rely on spreadsheets and phone calls, we build software that gives us — and our customers — a real edge. ️

The Role

You won't just write code here. You'll steer AI agents that write code, then make sure it's actually good. We use AI coding tools daily — not as novelties, but as core parts of how we ship software. Your job is to define the problem clearly, direct AI to build the solution, review every line it produces, and own what goes to production.

If that sounds like managing a small engineering team rather than being a solo coder — you're getting the idea.

What You'll Do

Break down business problems into clear specs and architectural prompts that guide AI agents toward correct solutions
Direct AI coding tools to generate, test, and iterate on code across our systems — from internal platforms to customer-facing products
Design system architecture — APIs, databases, integrations — and make decisions that hold up as we scale
Own features end-to-end: from understanding the business need, through implementation, to production deployment
Write tests that keep AI agents (and yourself) honest. Strong test coverage is how you move fast without breaking things
Collaborate directly with our team to translate real operational challenges in the steel industry into working software

What We Offer

We're a young team that builds things that matter — tools that impact how steel and building materials move across Indonesia. You'll have real freedom to explore ideas and make your own decisions. No one here is going to micromanage you.

Come with your bright ideas. Speak up. Challenge assumptions. That's how we work. ️

We invest seriously in learning — new tools, new skills, personal growth. You'll never stop getting better here. And you'll be part of a team that genuinely values your contributions and has fun doing the work.

We offer competitive compensation and benefits, because that's what good people deserve. ️
Minimum Qualifications: Must-Have Skills:

Solid engineering fundamentals — You know what good code looks like. Data structures, design patterns, debugging. You need this to catch what AI gets wrong
System design thinking — You can reason about how pieces fit together: APIs, databases, third-party integrations, deployment
AI coding tool experience — You've used Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools to build real software — not just experimented with them
Disciplined code review — You treat AI-generated code like a PR from an eager but sometimes careless junior engineer
Problem decomposition — You can take a vague business request and turn it into a series of concrete, buildable tasks
Testing instinct — You write tests not because someone told you to, but because you've seen what happens when you don't

Nice to have:

Experience with TypeScript, Javascript, or Python
Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Background in ERP systems, supply chain, or logistics software
Experience building internal tools or B2B products
Contributions to open-source projects or a portfolio we can look at
Sumber Makmur Surya Perkasa is an innovative steel and building materials distributor company in Indonesia. Founded in 2012 amid the growth of the economy and ongoing infrastructure development in Indonesia. We are going to disrupt the conventional construction industry by introducing digital channels for people to buy steel and building materials with ease, comfort, and secure. We also provide the best service and customer satisfaction with good quality goods and timely deliveries. SMS Perkasa is a collaboration of young professional teams and our board of directors with over 40 years of experience in the steel industry, so we can provide the best solutions and support for our customers' needs. We've become a trusted partner for many constructions and infrastructure projects throughout Indonesia.

descriptionText:
Job Description:

Purpose of the Role:

Responsible for managing technical adaptation and supporting manufacturing processes for MV/LV equipment, Managing and Preparing equipment for Surveillance test, ensuring product quality compliance, and providing mechanical design and simulation support for localization, productivity, and QVE initiatives.

Key Responsibilities:

Support the engineering team to:

Manage technical aspects of local adaptation for MV/LV equipment
Ensure and manage equipment availability for surveillance test
Ensure product quality conforms to specifications and standards
Design and modify mechanical parts for MV/LV equipment
Perform 3D simulations for problem analysis, productivity improvement, localization, and QVE
Assist in parts and components qualification related to mechanical properties
Prepare mechanical drawings (new, modified, standardized, unfolded) for MV/LV panels
Support configuration tool preparation and updates in Excel format or advance format
Calculate busbar and metallic parts for cost estimation and offering tools
Assist in prototype assembly, LIS checks, and production line troubleshooting
Provide technical solutions for customer complaints and ensure corrective actions to prevent recurrence
Ensure compliance with Quality, Safety, Health, and Environmental requirements (including RoHS)
Manage BOM database: download PDM (Product Data Management) BOM, perform Make-or-Buy analysis, and upload to One Shuttle
Support stakeholders (Purchasing, SCM) with drawing requests and standard part downloads from PDM

Expected Contributions:

Ensure smooth technical management of product evolution (PEP), AN, and MCN
Guarantee equipment quality and compliance with standards and customer requirements
Drive localization and productivity improvements through design and simulation
Maintain accurate BOM and drawing databases to support manufacturing and procurement processes
(External) English Qualifications:

What qualifications will make you successful for this role?

Active diploma/bachelor's degree student (max. 8th semester), from Electrical/Mechanical Engineering or related field.

Available to intern for 6 months minimum.

Technical Skills:

Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., Creo, AutoCAD, or equivalent)

Knowledge of MV/LV equipment design and mechanical properties and related IEC Standards

Familiarity with manufacturing processes and quality standards

Strong Excel skills for offering tool updates and cost calculations

Soft Skills:

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

Good communication and collaboration skills for cross-functional coordination

Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities

Other Requirements:

Understanding of Quality, Safety, Health, and Environmental standards (RoHS compliance)

Ability to work independently and as part of a team

title: DCEO Engineer, AWS Data Center Engineering Operations
descriptionText:
DESCRIPTION

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operation Senior Engineer is responsible for ensuring that all electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center is operating within contract parameters within third party Colocation facilities. Often this will be including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

Key job responsibilities
The DCEO Engineer will be responsible for Data Center Engineering Operations within an Amazon Data Center including risk management and mitigation, corrective and preventative maintenance of critical infrastructure, vendor management and metric reporting.

Responsibilities may include:
· Responsible for the on-site management of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation.
· Establish performance benchmarks, conduct analyses, and prepare reports on all aspects of the critical facility infrastructure operations and maintenance.
· Generate change management requests & incident management tickets for DCEO activities.
· Work with DCO managers (IT) and other business leaders to coordinate projects, manage capacity, and optimize plant safety, performance, reliability, sustainability and efficiency.
· Establish documentation relevant to business & facility operations (SOP, EOP, MOP, SWMS)
· Responsible for the installation of the racks and namely the provision of power/cooling hand off.
· Review and manage planned and unplanned maintenance and emergency services on a variety of critical systems such as: switch gear, generators, UPS systems, power distribution equipment, chillers, cooling towers, computer room air handlers, building monitoring systems, etc.
· Assist in the design, implementation, commissioning and build out of new facilities.
· Drive & implement projects to increase current facility capacity, efficiency, sustainability & reliability.
· Management of the provision of infrastructure & inventory asset management.
· Participate in regular operational meetings
· Review Work Order compliance & ensure all contractual SLA’s are achieved.
· Interface with Infra Ops Management for day to day operational requirements.
· Assist in recruiting efforts.
· Manage the resolution of any infrastructure engineering issues.
· Delivery of exceptional customer service and satisfaction.
Participate in a 24 x 7 rotating shift roster and cover shifts as required.

About the team
Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Windows/Desktop Applications - Jakarta, Indonesia
descriptionText:
Mission

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies

What You'll Do
Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
Drive accessibility efforts: integrate and validate support for accessibility APIs (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or other relevant Windows accessibility frameworks), ensure UI controls, focus management, keyboard navigation, screen-reader support, and usability for users with disabilities.
Collaborate closely with product designers, UX researchers, QA, and other stakeholders to shape feature planning, UI/UX architecture, and long-term roadmap for the Windows platform.
Take ownership of full lifecycle of features: conception → design → implementation → testing → release → maintenance. Ensure quality, reliability, and consistency across releases.
Identify, diagnose, and resolve complex bugs, performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, rendering issues, or compatibility problems — and propose robust architectural or design solutions.

An ideal candidate should have

Required:

3+ in Windows desktop application development using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or similar), C#, XAML — and ideally additional experience with native Windows code (C++, Win32/WinRT/COM).
Deep understanding of Windows application architecture, including interop between managed code (.NET) and native code.
Proven track record of designing, building, and shipping production-quality desktop applications, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, scalability, and maintainability.
Strong experience with accessibility APIs on Windows (e.g. Microsoft UI Automation or similar), and a dedication to building accessible and inclusive software.
Excellent software engineering fundamentals: OOP, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, memory management, multi-threading or asynchronous programming (where relevant).
Experience leading technical design, mentoring other engineers, conducting code reviews, and making architecture-level decisions.
Strong communication skills; ability to articulate tradeoffs, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and drive consensus.
A user-centric mindset: focus on building polished, intuitive, and accessible experiences for end users.

Preferred / Bonus:

Experience with writing automated tests for UI — unit tests, integration tests, UI automation tests; familiarity with relevant testing frameworks.
Experience with performance optimization for desktop apps (memory usage, startup time, rendering performance, high-DPI support, responsiveness under load).
Experience with localization/globalization, right-to-left UI support, internationalization, accessibility for multiple regions.
Familiarity with telemetry, analytics, crash reporting, logging, and error monitoring in desktop applications.
Previous experience in shaping CI/CD workflows, release pipelines, and deployment strategies for desktop applications.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of feature areas or modules and drive them long-term, including maintenance, refactoring, and technical debt management.

What we offer

A high-impact role: you will define architecture, shape the future of our Windows product, and directly influence what millions of users see and experience.
A collaborative, flat-structure engineering culture — you are not just a coder, but a builder and a decision-maker.
Opportunities to lead — mentor others, steer technical direction, and grow into broader technical leadership (e.g. Tech Lead, Architect).
Flexibility, autonomy, and responsibility: you define how to solve problems, own features end-to-end, and contribute to long-term product vision.
A purpose-driven mission: building software that's reliable, accessible, and user-centered — making a real difference for people.

Think you're a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?
Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.
Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

descriptionText:
Job Title

Procurement

Job Description Summary

The Procurement Specialist will oversee and execute the end-of-to-end purchasing, sourcing, and contract management strategies for all packages during the construction phase of our Data Center project. This role is critical in securing long-lead mission-critical equipment, civil/structural materials, and trade subcontractors, ensuring all transactions align with strict project timelines, budget constraints, and technical specifications.

Job Description

About the Role:

End-to-End Specialized Sourcing: Execute the procurement cycle for high-value, mission-critical equipment (UPS systems, chillers, generators, transformers) and manage priority manufacturing slots with global suppliers.

Subcontractor Tendering & RFPs: Draft, issue, and manage comprehensive RFPs/RFQs for civil, structural, architectural, and complex MEP trade packages.
Commercial Evaluation & Negotiation: Conduct rigorous commercial tender analyses, lead cost negotiations, and finalize purchase orders and FIDIC-based construction subcontracts.
Expediting & Supply Chain Controls: Monitor supplier factory production milestones and coordinate international logistics/customs clearance to ensure on-time delivery to the site, minimizing construction delays.
Budget & Change Management: Track procurement spend against the baseline project budget, identify cost-saving opportunities, and rigorously manage subcontractor variation/change orders.

About You:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Engineering (Civil, Mechanical, Electrical), or a related business field.
Industry Experience: Minimum 5+ years of heavy construction procurement experience, with a strict requirement for direct exposure to Data Centers, high-tech industrial plants, power infrastructure, or large-scale oil & gas projects.
Technical Competencies: Strong command of MEP technical frameworks, deep knowledge of international shipping/logistics for heavy machinery, and familiarity with structured contract terms (e.g., FIDIC).
Systems Proficiency: Hands-on experience using corporate ERP and procurement software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Ariba).
Languages: Professional-level fluency in both written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia to manage both international vendors and local site teams.

Why join Cushman & Wakefield?

As one of the leading global real estate services firms transforming the way people work, shop and live working at Cushman & Wakefield means you will benefit from;

Being part of a growing global company;
Career development and a promote from within culture;
An organisation committed to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to providing work-life balance for our people in an inclusive, rewarding environment.

We achieve this by providing a flexible and agile work environment by focusing on technology and autonomy to help our people achieve their career ambitions. We focus on career progression and foster a promotion from within culture, leveraging global opportunities to ensure we retain our top talent. We encourage continuous learning and development opportunities to develop personal, professional and technical capabilities, and we reward with a comprehensive employee benefits program.

We have a vision of the future, where people simply belong.

That's why we support and celebrate inclusive causes, not just on days of recognition throughout the year, but every day. We embrace diversity across race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or persons with disabilities or protected veteran status.

We ensure DEI is part of our DNA as a global community - it means we go way beyond than just talking about it - we live it. If you want to live it too, join us.

title: Animator
descriptionText:
Who are we?

Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.

We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.

Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.

Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.

We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games.

Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.

Role Overview

We are looking for a talented and collaborative Game Animator to join our team and help bring characters, props, and gameplay interactions to life. In this role, you will work closely with Artists, Designers, Technical Artists, and Engineers to create polished and optimized animations for mobile games.

You will be responsible for producing high-quality animations, supporting rigging and implementation workflows, and ensuring animations feel responsive, appealing, and aligned with the overall game vision.

Key Responsibilities

Create and implement 3D animations for characters, props, and interactive elements, including idle, movement, combat, and UI-related animations.
Rig and skin characters and assets when needed, ensuring clean deformation and efficient setups.
Collaborate with Technical Artists to ensure animations are optimized for mobile performance and function correctly in Unity.
Integrate animations into the game engine, set up Animator Controllers, and support basic animation state machines.
Work closely with Designers and Producers to iterate on animations based on gameplay needs and player experience feedback.
Maintain consistency in animation quality, style, timing, and polish across the project.
Troubleshoot animation, rigging, and implementation issues directly in-engine.
Follow project pipelines, technical requirements, file structures, and naming conventions.
Contribute to improving animation workflows and best practices within the team.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Art, Design, Engineering, and QA teams throughout development.

Required Skills, Knowledge, and Expertise

3+ years of experience as a Game Animator.
Strong understanding of animation principles, including timing, spacing, weight, anticipation, and polish.
Proficiency in 3D animation tools such as Blender, Maya, or equivalent software.
Experience with character rigging and skinning workflows.
Familiarity with Unity animation systems, Animator Controllers, and basic state machines.
Understanding of optimization techniques for mobile game performance.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Designers, Artists, Technical Artists, Engineers, and Producers.
Strong problem-solving skills for troubleshooting animation and rigging issues in-engine.
Ability to follow production pipelines, naming conventions, and technical constraints.
Good communication skills and openness to feedback and iteration.

Industry: Game Development / Game Outsourcing / iGaming

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced *Quality Director* to lead and scale the Quality Assurance function for our iGaming and game outsourcing projects. This role is responsible for building robust QA strategies, optimizing testing processes, managing large-scale distributed QA teams, and driving continuous quality improvement across multiple international projects.

The ideal candidate has strong experience in both strategic QA leadership and operational execution, especially in managing *large QA organizations across multiple locations or semi-independent teams*. Experience applying *AI solutions into software testing workflows* is a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities*QA Strategy & Process Management*

* Design, implement, and continuously improve QA frameworks, testing standards, and quality governance processes for iGaming and game development projects.
* Build scalable testing pipelines covering functional, regression, performance, compatibility, automation, and live-operation testing.
* Establish and optimize QA workflows to improve product quality, release stability, and operational efficiency.
* Define QA KPIs, reporting structures, and quality metrics across projects.

*Test Planning & Optimization*

* Lead the creation, refinement, and optimization of:
* Test Plans
* Test Cases
* Test Strategies
* QA Documentation
* Streamline and standardize testing assets to improve execution efficiency while maintaining high test coverage.
* Drive risk-based testing methodologies and continuous process improvements.

*Team Leadership & Organization Scaling*

* Manage and scale *large QA teams*, including multi-layer management structures.
* Build and operate QA organizations with *semi-independent teams across different locations/countries*.
* Develop organizational structures, resource allocation models, and collaboration processes for distributed teams.
* Mentor QA Managers, Leads, and senior QA members to strengthen leadership capability across the organization.
* Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to align quality goals with business objectives.

*Innovation & AI Adoption*

* Research and evaluate emerging QA technologies, tools, and methodologies.
* Explore and implement AI-driven testing solutions, including:
* AI-assisted test generation
* Automated defect analysis
* Intelligent regression testing
* QA productivity optimization
* Drive innovation initiatives to improve testing speed, coverage, and quality.

Requirements*Must-Have*

* 10+ years of experience in QA/QC within software, gaming, or iGaming industries.
* Proven experience as QA Director / Head of QA / Senior QA Manager or equivalent leadership role.
* Strong experience building QA processes from scratch and scaling QA operations.
* Experience managing *large-scale QA organizations* (not only small teams), including:
* Multiple QA Leads/Managers
* Cross-functional QA structures
* Distributed or multi-location teams
* Solid understanding of:
* Manual Testing
* Test Automation
* Performance Testing
* SDLC/STLC
* Agile/Scrum methodologies
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-cultural communication skills.
* Fluent English communication.

*Preferred Qualifications*

* Experience in iGaming, online betting, casino, sportsbook, or game outsourcing environments.
* Experience managing international or remote QA teams.
* Hands-on experience integrating AI tools or AI-assisted workflows into QA/testing processes.
* Familiarity with automation frameworks and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience working in fast-scaling international companies.

Benefits

* Competitive *international compensation package*
* *Full relocation support to Vietnam* (visa, housing assistance, relocation allowance)
* Opportunity to work with *global teams and international markets*
* Fast-growing company with strong expansion plans in the iGaming sector

Dynamic and innovative working environment

title: Automation Engineering Asia Pacific
descriptionText:
E80 Group specializes in the creation of automated and integrated logistics solutions for companies producing consumer goods in the beverage, food, tissue and diversified sectors. Thanks to the use of innovative technologies and through the analysis of its customers' logistics processes, the company has anticipated the concept of Industry 4.0: the intelligent, sustainable and interconnected factory.

The main systems created by E80 Group and BEMA are: palletizing robots, a wide range of laser-guided vehicles (LGV/AGV), high-speed robotic wrappers (SILKWORM), pallet control systems, robotic labelers, high-speed depalletizing solutions layer and repacking and high-density automatic warehouses (SMART STORE AND CRANE STORE). The entire logistics flow is managed centrally by a single SM.I.LE80 (Smart Integrated Logistics) software platform: the "conductor" that ensures the efficient integration of the systems, guaranteeing the optimal management of all operations, from entry of raw materials to storage, up to shipments.

To date, E80 Group has built approximately 300 integrated factories in different parts of the world, installing over 2,000 robotic systems, more than 5,000 automatic laser-guided vehicles and 30 high-density automatic warehouses.

The Group has grown by focusing on some fundamental assets: valorization of people and the territory, investments in research, development and innovation as well as proactive adaptability to market needs.

The Automation Engineer will be placed in the Customer Services Operations department which in E80 deals with all operational activities relating to post-sales. This position will mainly deal with preventive maintenance, repair, modification, upgrade and inspection activities on all types of machines installed at customer sites.

Responsibilities

* Ensure the efficiency of all the machines making up the E80 system through inspections and maintenance at periodic intervals or upon failure
* Perform preventative maintenance tasks
* Perform corrective maintenance or electrical and mechanical troubleshooting activities on machines
* Perform calibration or configuration of individual machines or devices
* Perform partial or complete upgrade or modification activities on our obsolete systems;
* Draw up post-intervention reports and spare parts lists
* Monitor the correct functioning of the E80 system by informing those directly responsible about problems or anomalies found and/or to be resolved

Qualifications

* Diploma or bachelor's degree in Electromechanical or automation Engineering
* Good/excellent ability to read and interpret electrical, hydraulic, and mechanical drawing diagrams
* Minimum experience with Siemens, Beckhoff, Lenze, and/or FANUC control systems will be considered a plus
* Pro-active attitude, dynamism, and strong problem-solving skills
* Availability and adaptation to operate outside of the hours/days considered ordinary if the need so requires
* Resistance to stress and working under pressure
* Proficient in MS. Office
* Fluent in English
* Willing to be placed in Batang (Central Java) or Cikarang (West Java)
* Willing to travel around Asia and Oceania

We are seeking a motivated Intern to join our team and assist in Sustainability Department. This internship provides an excellent opportunity for an active student to gain hands-on experience in a dynamic environment.
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.

title: Senior QA Engineer II - SDET
descriptionText:
Mekari is Indonesia's no. 1 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company. With our ecosystem of software solutions—including Mekari Jurnal, Mekari Talenta, Mekari Qontak, and Mekari Flex, we aim to facilitate entrepreneurs and leaders as they accelerate the digital transformation of their businesses.

In our 10+ years of journey we have reached over 1 Million platform users, and we're not planning to stop any time soon. We need more people like you: builders and owners with calculated ambition who are eager to grow and create their #BiggestImpact.

The Mission
We are looking for a visionary Senior QA Engineer II - SDET to lead the convergence of Quality Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. You will be responsible for building the next generation of our "Self-Healing" automation infrastructure and establishing the guardrails for testing our proprietary AI/ML features. You are a developer first, with a passion for quality and a deep understanding of the modern AI stack.

Key Responsibilities :

AI-Driven Infrastructure: Design and build internal tools that leverage LLMs or Machine Learning to auto-generate test cases, identify flaky tests, and perform root-cause analysis on logs.
Testing "The Black Box": Develop frameworks to validate AI model outputs, ensuring accuracy, identifying hallucinations, and monitoring for data drift in production.
Architecture & Strategy: Set the technical standards for automation across all squads. Ensure our framework is modular, scalable, and capable of running thousands of tests in parallel.
Shift-Right Quality: Implement AI-powered observability and synthetic monitoring to catch regressions in production before users do.
Mentorship: Act as the highest technical authority for the QA guild, upskilling Senior SDETs in AI/ML testing patterns.

Technical Requirements :

Core Engineering: 8+ years of experience in Software Engineering or SDET roles, with mastery of Typescript/Python (preferred for AI) or Java/Go.
AI/ML Proficiency: * Experience with LLM integration (OpenAI API, LangChain, or LlamaIndex) for automation.
Understanding of model evaluation metrics (e.g., ROUGE, BLEU, or custom scoring via GPT-4-as-a-judge).
Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Milvus) and prompt engineering.
Advanced Automation: Expert-level experience with Playwright or Cypress and building custom libraries on top of them.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency with Terraform, Docker, and Kubernetes to manage isolated test environments.
Data Science Lite: Ability to use SQL and data visualization tools to analyze large sets of test results for predictive trends.

The "AI Specialist" Requirements :

Model Observability: Experience with tools like Weights & Biases or Arize to monitor model performance.
Prompt Regression: Experience building "Golden Datasets" to ensure new model deployments don't degrade existing prompt responses.
Security & Bias: Knowledge of AI security (Prompt Injection testing) and bias detection in automated decision-making.

Don't forget to check our Recruitment FAQ at https://bit.ly/FAQMekariRecruitment [ENG] or https://bit.ly/FAQRekrutmenMekari [INA] to find the answers to commonly asked questions regarding our recruitment process.

We wish you the best. Hope to see you around soon!

title: Paid Media Video Editor
descriptionText:
Paid Media Video Editor

We are seeking a highly capable Paid Media Video Editor to take absolute ownership of the video, motion, and image-based creatives for paid social campaigns. The role involves high-level creation of direct-response ads and high-converting marketing assets using industry-standard editing software. This role is not about basic editing or generic social media posting; it is a specialized position focused on driving commercial growth through data-backed visual storytelling. You will have the opportunity to collaborate with an elite full-funnel digital marketing agency working with premium eCommerce brands across beauty, wellness, health, fashion, jewellery, and consumer products.

Part-time: 20 hours per week
Remote: Fully remote
Engagement Type: Independent Contractor
Monthly Rate: Flexible, depending on experience

What You'll Be Doing:
Direct Response Creative Production
Design and execute high-performing video ads, slick motion graphics, and static image assets specifically engineered for Meta and TikTok feeds.
Apply a refined aesthetic and strong creative taste to ensure all assets align with premium consumer brand positionings.
Maintain visual consistency, crisp typography, and high-production polish across every single frame.
Creative Strategy & Ideation
Develop native-feeling creative concepts, aggressive hooks, angles, and psychological visual triggers tailored to target consumer personas.
Produce content specifically localized and optimized to resonate with UK and European-based consumer brands and audiences.
Stay continuously ahead of the curve regarding TikTok trends, Meta algorithm preferences, and shifts in digital consumer behavior.
Data Analysis & Iteration
Review post-campaign creative data and analytics to provide clear, actionable insights into why specific assets underperformed or drove conversions.
Contribute to and execute complex creative testing frameworks, iterating rapidly on hooks, messaging matrices, visual formats, and CTAs.
Prevent ad fatigue by systematically engineering multiple variations of proven winning concepts.
AI Workflow Optimization
Seamlessly weave advanced generative AI tools into your daily production workflow to accelerate ideation, speed up asset variation, and elevate editing efficiency.
Use AI to scale creative output without compromising on the quality, realism, or premium standards of the final brand assets.

Who You Are:
5+ years of professional experience in video editing, motion design, creative strategy, or paid social creative production.
Proven, hands-on experience creating high-converting paid media creatives for consumer product eCommerce brands (specifically beauty, wellness, health, fashion, or jewellery).
Expert-level proficiency in traditional editing and motion tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop) alongside advanced use of creative AI tools.
Experience working with UK/European-based brands, companies, or target consumer audiences.
Strong understanding of performance marketing, direct-response principles, and how to analyze retention curves or creative metrics.
High attention to detail, commercial intelligence, and an eye for high aesthetic standards.
Ability to work independently in a remote environment, taking raw briefs and data to deliver exceptional visual execution without constant instruction.

descriptionText:
About HDF Energy

Founded in 2012, HDF Energy is a leading global player in the hydrogen sector, with two main activities. As an industrial company, HDF designs and manufactures high-power fuel cells at its factory in Blanquefort, near Bordeaux. These cutting-edge technologies produce electricity from hydrogen, with the aim of decarbonising power generation for public electricity grids, as well as heavy maritime and rail mobility. As a hydrogen infrastructure architect, HDF Energy designs and develops large turnkey hydrogen infrastructures to produce low-carbon hydrogen and clean electricity. Through dedicated project companies, we also finance, build and operate these facilities.

Our flagship model is the Renewstable, a multi-megawatt power plant delivering non-intermittent renewable, stable and baseload power, 24/7, by seamlessly integrating intermittent renewable energy sources (solar or wind) with substantial on-site energy storage in the form of green hydrogen. These plants are being developed in more than twenty countries around the world.

Backed by a team of over 100+ hydrogen experts boasting more than a decade of operational experience across the value chain, HDF Energy is currently developing a portfolio of advanced projects valued at over €2 billion.

Headquartered in France, HDF Energy has regional offices in Latin America, the Caribbean, Africa and the Asia-Pacific region with 35+ nationalities among its staff. Since 2021, the Group has been listed on the Euronext Paris stock market.

HDF Energy operates across eight countries in the Asia Pacific region, including Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Japan, India, Australia, and Fiji, with our regional headquarters based in Jakarta. We are currently offering a six-month internship opportunity in Indonesia for one candidate, who must be based in Jakarta and is expected to start in June 2026.

Perform research covering topic on electrical grid, power system and/or Renewable Energy integration to the grid for APAC region

Provide support to APAC team during grid impact study with external consultant

Perform research covering topic on permitting and licensing related to integration of RE into the grid system

Undergraduate final-year student, fresh graduate, or master’s student in in Electrical/Power System Engineering.

Experience using power system simulation software (ETAP, Power Factory DigSilent, etc)

Familiar with solar power plants will be appreciated

Proactive and solution-oriented.

Proficiency in English at a professional level is a must.

Demonstrated proactivity and autonomy.

Excellent research, communication and interpersonal skills.

Strong team spirit and adaptability.

Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Words, Excel, Power Point, Teams, Sharepoint).

title: Business Intelligence
descriptionText:
Mekari is Indonesia's no. 1 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company. With our ecosystem of software solutions—including Mekari Jurnal, Mekari Talenta, Mekari Qontak, and Mekari Flex, we aim to facilitate entrepreneurs and leaders as they accelerate the digital transformation of their businesses.

In our 10+ years of journey we have reached over 1 Million platform users, and we're not planning to stop any time soon. We need more people like you: builders and owners with calculated ambition who are ready to #ElevateThroughImpact and raise Indonesia's software standard.

Job Description:

Define and implement BI & analytic strategies to uncover actionable insights and opportunities from our existing data.
Perform analysis and generate insights and recommendations to support the business/product in decision-making, applying statistical methods and using AI tools where helpful to work faster and at scale.
Improve processes by applying BI best practices and sensible automation.
Manage data products and disseminate information.
Consult with internal customers (e.g. Operation, Commercial, Product, etc.) to develop analyses that lead to actionable insights.
Collect data from multiple sources to create integrated views that can be used to drive decision-making.
In charge of the day-to-day analytical requirements, communicating issues, and suggesting remedial action and improvements where appropriate.
Oversee the execution of strategy recommendations for intelligence/data-driven capacity.
Accountable for data integrity and quality, ensuring it is continuously maintained and improved.
Develop and update technical documentation as necessary.

Requirements/Qualifications:

2+ years of experience with Big Data/Analytics platforms like R or Python (preferred).
2+ years of experience with BI tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Solid grounding in statistics and statistical modeling (e.g. distributions, correlation, regression) and the ability to apply it to business problems.
Comfortable using AI/LLM tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Claude) to support analysis; ability to call an LLM API from Python is a plus.
Analytical mindset and ability to see the big picture and influence others.
Detail-oriented and an aptitude for solving unstructured problems, with the ability to extract data from various sources and design/construct/execute complex analyses.
Background in data warehouse design (e.g. dimensional modeling) and data mining.
Familiarity with BI technologies.
Familiar with one or more querying languages (e.g. SQL, PostgreSQL).
Proven ability to take initiative and be innovative.
Analytical mind with a problem-solving aptitude.
BSc/BA in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant field.

Working Arrangement: Hybrid.

Office location: Sudirman, Jakarta, Indonesia.

Our team will review your application and will be in touch if your application is shortlisted to the next stage. If you do not hear from us in 30 days, we will keep your resume on file in case a relevant opportunity opens up.

Don't forget to check our Recruitment FAQ at https://bit.ly/FAQMekariRecruitment [ENG] or https://bit.ly/FAQRekrutmenMekari [INA] to find the answers to commonly-asked questions regarding our recruitment process.

We wish you the best, and hope to see you around soon!

● Preferably having experience in Glass Lined Reactor (GLR)

Work Location: In person

descriptionText:
We think you also hate when travel app is giving you a headache, right? A slight misinformation can ruin the trip.

That is exactly what we are tackling as t-fam! Making sure that our 50+ million users have the best experience in crafting their own adventure.

Fullstack Engineer Intern - Data Platform
As a Data Platform Intern, you will sit at the intersection of full-stack engineering and data engineering. Your mission is to bridge the gap between complex big data systems and the end-users (other product and tech teams) by building and maintaining "Data as a Service" (DaaS) products. This is a unique opportunity for a Fullstack Engineer to gain deep exposure to big data processing, security, and scalable infrastructure.

Your main duties in flying with us:
• Assist in designing new backend services
• Create a Rest API server
• Make documentation API contract with front-end engineers
• Having hands-on experience in Golang is preferable
• Having hands-on experience in Databases such as MySQL and PostgreSQL
• Preferred to have knowledge on how to fetch data from other services

Mandatory belongings that you must prepare:
• Ability to develop software in Python & Go (Node JS is additional point)
• Excellent knowledge of relational databases, SQL, and ORM
• Experience developing REST API services
• Have a good knowledge of SOLID principles and design patterns
• Ability to read/write document requirements and specifications

In the event that you haven’t received any updates after 3 weeks, your data will be kept and we may contact you for another career destination. Meanwhile, discover more about tiket.com on Instagram , LinkedIn , or YouTube .
