title: Senior Software Engineer, Frontend
location/streetAddress: Dipo Business Center,10260 Jakarta Pusat,Indonesia
descriptionText:
What we're looking for

We are seeking a talented, endlessly curious individual to join our team. You’ll be working closely with our group of companies in the fintech sector as part of the Engineering department. This company is a leading B2B fintech platform in its field, processing over US$2B across multiple currencies annually. We’re looking for individuals who are driven to create meaningful value, take full ownership of what they build, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. If you’re motivated by impactful work and eager to be part of an innovative team, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll do

Design, build, and maintain modern frontend applications using Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS

Build and maintain component libraries and design systems, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and reusability

Collaborate with backend engineers to design clean, efficient API contracts

Ensure high standards of code quality through thorough testing, code reviews, and documentation

Investigate and resolve frontend production issues, including layout bugs, interaction quirks, and degraded performance

Mentor junior engineers and help improve team practices in frontend architecture, testing, and performance tuning

Collaborate closely with product managers and designers to shape and deliver seamless user experiences

What you should have

5+ years of experience in frontend development, with at least 2+ years in React and Next.js

Knowledge of both server-side and client side rendering especially in relation of Next.js

Deep understanding of the modern web platform: rendering models, hydration, performance budgets, accessibility

Strong UI/UX sensibility — able to translate Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive, accessible UIs

Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library

Comfortable with SSR, dynamic routing, caching strategies, and web performance optimization

Familiarity with common frontend testing strategies (E2E, unit, integration)

Ability to work autonomously and collaborate cross-functionally with design, backend, and product teams

Strong communication skills — able to explain trade-offs clearly and mentor others effectively

Bonus Points

Prior experience working in fintech or payments

Familiarity with building design systems or working with internal design systems

Experience building and debugging authentication/authorization flows, especially in multi-tenant systems

Experience writing technical/architecture document like RFC/ADR

About Us

Xenith is a B2B payment service provider focused on enabling seamless cross-border commerce. With an MSB license in Canada and PJP III license in Indonesia, we offer global merchants a one-stop solution to manage multi-currency payments - with a strong focus on alternative payment methods in emerging markets. Our deep regional expertise and strong partnerships with top local gateways, we simplify the complexity of fragmented payment landscapes, helping global merchants expand faster and more efficiently. At Xenith, we believe in building a culture where people feel empowered, trusted, and challenged to do their best work. Join us as we build the financial infrastructure of tomorrow!

title: Software Engineer, iOS Core Product - Jakarta, Indonesia
descriptionText:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our iOS app, being the #18 productivity app in the App Store category and also our recent recognition as Apple's 2025 Design Award for inclusivity, we find the need for a Senior iOS Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push our missing forward.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week.

What You'll Do

Opportunity to lead key engineering and product decisions
Actively shipping production code for the Speechify iOS app
Work within a dedicated product team
Participate in product discussions to shape the product roadmap
Maintain and enhance the existing complex app architecture

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

Experience. You've worked on products that scaled to a large user base
Track record. You have worked on various products from inception to decent traction. You have been responsible for engineering the product
Customer obsession. We expect every team member whose responsibilities directly impact customers to be constantly obsessed about providing the best possible experience
Product thinking. You make thoughtful decisions about the evolution of your product and support internal teams and designers into taking the right direction
Speed. You work quickly to generate ideas and know how to decide which things can ship now and what things need time
Focus. We're a high-growth startup with a busy, remote team. You know how and when to engage or be heads down
Technical skills. Swift, SwiftUI

Technical Requirements:

Swift Programming Language
SwiftUI experience
Experience in Multithreading Programming
Working with CI/CD infrastructure
Experience with Fastlane
SOLID principles, the ability to write every single class according to SOLID
Experience with Git and understanding of different Git strategies

What We offer:

A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product
An entrepreneurial crew that supports risk, intuition, and hustle
The opportunity to make a big impact in a transformative industry
A competitive salary, a collegiate atmosphere, and a commitment to building a great asynchronous culture
Work on a product that millions of people use and where daily feedback includes users sharing that they cried when they first found the product because it was so impactful on their lives
Support people with learning differences like Dyslexia, ADD, Low Vision, Concussions, Autism, and Second Language Learners, and give reading superpowers to professionals all over the world
Work in one of the fastest growing sectors of tech: Intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Audio

Think you're a good fit for this job?

Tell us more about yourself and why you're interested in the role when you apply.
And don't forget to include links to your portfolio and LinkedIn.

Not looking but know someone who would make a great fit?

Refer them!

Speechify is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.

Speechify does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Staff Software Engineer
descriptionText:
About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer (Technical Architect, Senior level) to lead the design and evolution of Flip's technical architecture. In this role, you will shape how our systems are built, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, secure, and aligned with our long-term engineering vision.

You'll work closely with engineering leaders, product managers, and cross-functional teams to translate business challenges into robust technical solutions. Beyond building systems, you'll set engineering standards, mentor teams, and drive initiatives that strengthen Flip's technology foundation.

This is a high-impact role where you'll play a key part in guiding technical excellence across multiple domains, influencing architectural direction, and helping Flip continue to scale securely and sustainably.

About Flip

Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year.

We’re backed by leading investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia, and our mission is simple: to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.

At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits.

What You'll Do

Develop software design and architecture across multiple domains, ensuring alignment with broader engineering strategy.
Define and uphold engineering standards for code quality, system performance, security, and maintainability.
Tackle challenges related to scale, performance, and reliability using strong algorithmic and architectural expertise.
Coach engineers and lead technical discussions to drive high-quality engineering practices across the team.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally. Partnering with Product Managers and cross-functional leaders to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Anticipate technical debt, propose re-architectures when needed, and ensure systems are built with long-term sustainability in mind.
Contribute to internal knowledge sessions, documentation, and external tech communities.

What You'll Need

8+ years of experience in software engineering, with proven experience in system design and architecture.
Strong proficiency in modern backend technologies and architectural patterns (e.g. microservices, event-driven systems).
Solid understanding of databases, performance optimization, and distributed systems.
Deep experience defining SLOs and ensuring scalability, reliability, and observability.
Strong grasp of software security principles and best practices.
Excellent coding and problem-solving skills with attention to clean, maintainable design.
Proven ability to influence technical direction and mentor senior engineers.
Effective communicator with strong collaboration and leadership abilities.
Experience working in high-scale environments (fintech, e-commerce, or other tech-driven companies) would be an advantage
Experience leading platform improvement or re-architecture initiatives also would be an advantage

title: Civil Engineering Intern
descriptionText:
About the Role

Pinhome is looking for a highly structured Civil Engineering Intern to support our Home Repair and Renovation team in maintaining and elevating service excellence for Pinhome Home Service's (PHS) growth category. In this role, you will help uphold service excellence standards, assist with technical drafting and modeling using engineering software, and gain hands-on experience in project budgeting, cost estimation, construction methods, building materials, and local codes.

This is a highly cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with the Home Repair and Renovation Category Owner, the Interior Design team, and the Operations team on incident handling and strategic alignment. You will report directly to the Home Repair & Renovation Category Manager and work alongside related project teams as needed.

What You Will Do

Technical Drafting & Office Operations:

Support the preparation and review of technical drawings and project documentation using tools such as AutoCAD (including shop drawings).

Convert survey data and field sketches into accurate, production-ready working drawings.

Assist in preparing cost estimations, project budgets, and work schedules.

Support project reporting and maintain organized documentation, including technical drawings and blueprints for active projects.

Participate in site inspections and help ensure projects comply with quality and safety standards.

Fieldwork & Technical Coordination:

Assist in conducting site visits to verify dimensions, leveling, and ensure that construction execution aligns with working drawings.

Coordinate with the surveying team during measurement, staking out, and field data collection processes.

Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual field conditions, and report findings directly to the Project Manager.

Support the Site Engineer in handling minor technical decision-making on-site.

Assist in creating initial sketches, and detailed architectural layouts for projects.

Monitor project milestones and prepare comprehensive work progress reports.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support day-to-day project operations and reporting.

What You Will Need

Technical Qualifications:

Fresh graduates or final-year students pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (prior internship, organizational, or project handling experience will be a plus)

Proficient in AutoCAD 2D for preparing technical drawings and project documentation; other experiences using other drafting or modeling software such as SketchUp and Revit is a plus.

Solid understanding of construction methods, building materials, and Indonesian civil engineering drawing standards.

Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze civil engineering blueprints and technical data.

Familiarity with field measurement processes (leveling, staking out, and reading survey data).

Basic understanding of volume calculations (cut & fill, embankments, drainage) for Bill of Quantities (BOQ) preparation.

Soft Skills:

Exceptional attention to detail, highly organized, and capable of multitasking across several active projects.

Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with field teams, surveyors, Project Managers, and corporate management.

Proactive mindset in identifying, troubleshooting, and reporting technical issues on-site.

Highly creative with a strong target-oriented and problem-solving attitude.

This is a highly cross-functional role requiring close collaboration with the Home Repair and Renovation Category Owner, the Interior Design team, and the Operations team on incident handling and strategic alignment. You will report directly to the Home Repair & Renovation Category Manager and work alongside related project teams as needed.

What You Will Do


Technical Drafting & Office Operations:

  • Support the preparation and review of technical drawings and project documentation using tools such as AutoCAD (including shop drawings).

  • Convert survey data and field sketches into accurate, production-ready working drawings.

  • Assist in preparing cost estimations, project budgets, and work schedules.

  • Support project reporting and maintain organized documentation, including technical drawings and blueprints for active projects.

  • Participate in site inspections and help ensure projects comply with quality and safety standards.

  • Assist in conducting site visits to verify dimensions, leveling, and ensure that construction execution aligns with working drawings.

  • Coordinate with the surveying team during measurement, staking out, and field data collection processes.

  • Identify discrepancies between drawings and actual field conditions, and report findings directly to the Project Manager.

  • Support the Site Engineer in handling minor technical decision-making on-site.

  • Assist in creating initial sketches, and detailed architectural layouts for projects.

  • Monitor project milestones and prepare comprehensive work progress reports.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support day-to-day project operations and reporting.

Technical Qualifications:


  • Fresh graduates or final-year students pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (prior internship, organizational, or project handling experience will be a plus)

  • Proficient in AutoCAD 2D for preparing technical drawings and project documentation; other experiences using other drafting or modeling software such as SketchUp and Revit is a plus.

  • Solid understanding of construction methods, building materials, and Indonesian civil engineering drawing standards.

  • Strong ability to read, interpret, and analyze civil engineering blueprints and technical data.

  • Familiarity with field measurement processes (leveling, staking out, and reading survey data).

  • Basic understanding of volume calculations (cut & fill, embankments, drainage) for Bill of Quantities (BOQ) preparation.

Soft Skills:

  • Exceptional attention to detail, highly organized, and capable of multitasking across several active projects.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with field teams, surveyors, Project Managers, and corporate management.

  • Proactive mindset in identifying, troubleshooting, and reporting technical issues on-site.

  • Highly creative with a strong target-oriented and problem-solving attitude.

title: Coding Specialist (Fluent in Indonesian) - Freelance AI Trainer Project
descriptionText:
Are you a coding expert fluent in Indonesian eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow's AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline software development for engineers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We're looking for coding specialists who live and breathe algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming—and who can do so fluently in Indonesian. You'll challenge advanced language models on topics like asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding practices, and debugging distributed systems—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

Ready to turn your coding and Indonesian language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow's AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8‑to‑$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you'll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Software Quality Engineer - (Public Sector)
descriptionText:
At Xtremax, we believe quality engineering is more than just testing — it’s about building confidence, reliability, and great digital experiences at scale. As a Software Quality Engineer, you will work alongside product managers, software engineers, and DevSecOps teams to deliver secure, high-quality digital products.

You will be part of agile, DevOps-driven teams where automation, continuous improvement, and engineering excellence are core to the way we build software. This role offers the opportunity to work on meaningful public sector systems while growing your expertise in test automation, CI/CD practices, performance testing, and modern software delivery.

Responsibilities

Collaborate with Product Owners and Business Analysts to define clear and actionable user story acceptance criteria
Work with Software Engineers to ensure automated test coverage and prevent bugs and defects in production
Analyse and decompose complex software systems to design holistic, risk-based test strategies
Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using industry-standard tools
Design and execute functional, regression, exploratory, and performance test suites
Maintain regression test suites integrated into QA nightly builds and CI/CD pipelines
Lead system integration testing and support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities
Manage defect lifecycle, test artefacts, and test repositories to ensure proper tracking and reporting
Drive continuous improvement in agile testing practices, tools, and methodologies
Support application performance engineering and application security testing initiatives where required

Requirements

Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology, or related disciplines
Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or QA engineering roles
Strong knowledge of test automation strategies and risk-based testing
Hands-on experience with manual and automated testing for web, mobile, and API services
Experience with test automation frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Robot Framework, Cypress, SikuliX, or EggPlant
Knowledge of test scripting and automation programming using Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#
Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Bamboo
Strong understanding of agile testing methodologies including TDD, BDD, exploratory testing, and shift-left testing approaches
Experience working in Agile environments such as Scrum, Kanban, or XP
Familiarity with containerised testing environments and modern DevOps practices
Experience with performance testing (JMeter, Gatling, k6, Locust) and application security testing (OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, SAST, DAST) tools is an added advantage
Experience managing defect tracking and test repositories using tools such as JIRA, TestRail, or Micro Focus ALM (QC/Sprinter)
Certified Software Testing Professional (CSTP) and/or Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA) certifications are an advantage

Benefits

You also represent to us that you have obtained the consent of your referees when you disclose to us their personal data for the purpose of conducting reference checks.

The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here: https://www.xtremax.com/privacy-policy

We regret to inform you that should you not consent to providing the necessary data required for us to process your application, your application will be considered void.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
descriptionText:
Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

What You Will Do
Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.
Who You Are
You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you.
High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.
Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level
6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.
Not Suitable for the Role If…
You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.
Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.

Why You'll Love Working Here
100% Remote Work
15 Days of Annual Leave
Annual Performance Bonus
Remote Work Allowance
Anniversary Bonus
Health Insurance
Company Activities and Events
Learning and Development Plan

CoverGo Company Video

title: Coding Specialist (Fluent in Indonesian) - Freelance AI Trainer Project
descriptionText:
Are you a coding expert fluent in Indonesian eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow's AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline software development for engineers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We're looking for coding specialists who live and breathe algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming—and who can do so fluently in Indonesian. You'll challenge advanced language models on topics like asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding practices, and debugging distributed systems—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on software engineering tasks and technical scenarios in Indonesian, verify logical accuracy and coding fluency, assess naturalness and correctness of Indonesian language usage, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor's or master's in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field is ideal; real-world coding experience, technical writing in Indonesian, or open-source contributions signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—"showing your work"—is essential.

Ready to turn your coding and Indonesian language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow's AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8‑to‑$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you'll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

descriptionText:
*QA Lead, Stability Expert (Fintech)*

*Company:* Quantum Realm Engineering

*Industry:* IT

*Work format:* Remote

*Employment type:* Full-time

*Experience required:* More than 2 years

*English level:* Advanced

*Key Skills*

* Responsibility
* Test case writing
* Attention to detail
* Manual testing
* Project management
* Test plan preparation
* Software Development Life Cycle
* Automation testing
* Scenario writing
* Software development
* Team management

*Job Description*

Quantum Realm Engineering is looking for an experienced QA Lead and Stability Expert to join our team.

This role is suited to a hands-on QA professional who can take ownership of quality assurance, improve application stability and lead the testing approach across a complex fintech product.

The core application has been in development for three years. While testing is already in place, the product now needs a stronger QA process, better stability controls and a more structured approach to manual and automated testing.

*Location and Schedule*

This is a remote role.

We prefer candidates based in the Asia time zone, ideally between UTC+8 and UTC+11, with working hours that overlap well with Sydney time.

Some overlap with Kyiv time is also needed for communication with the development team.

*Key Responsibilities*

The successful candidate will be responsible for setting and improving the quality standard across the product.

*QA Process Setup*

Define, implement and document a modern QA framework.

This includes improving current processes, selecting suitable tools and making sure the QA approach is clear, practical and followed by the team.

*Stability and Performance Improvement*

Review the existing application and identify the main stability risks.

Create and apply testing strategies that directly improve reliability, performance and user experience.

title: Unity AR Developer
descriptionText:
About the Role

We are seeking a skilled Unity AR Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of the Smart Garden Monitoring System — a cutting-edge mobile application that combines IoT, cloud computing, and augmented reality technologies to help users track and manage plant health efficiently.

As a Unity AR Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining the augmented reality features of our mobile application, working closely with our cloud and IoT engineering teams to deliver an immersive smart gardening experience.

Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop augmented reality (AR) features using Unity for iOS and Android platforms

- Implement AR overlays to visualize plant health data, environmental conditions, and IoT sensor readings in real-time

- Integrate Unity AR modules with AWS cloud services and mobile backend APIs

- Collaborate with IoT and mobile app teams to ensure seamless data flow between sensors, the cloud, and AR interfaces

- Build and maintain interactive 3D plant models and AR user interfaces

- Optimize AR performance for smooth and responsive user experiences on mobile devices

- Conduct unit testing, debugging, and performance profiling of AR features

- Stay up to date with the latest AR frameworks (ARCore, ARKit) and Unity development best practices

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Game Development, or related field

- Proven experience in Unity3D development with a strong portfolio of AR/VR or mobile projects

- Proficiency in C# programming and Unity engine

- Experience with ARCore (Android) and/or ARKit (iOS) frameworks

- Familiarity with mobile app development for iOS and Android

- Understanding of RESTful APIs and cloud service integration (AWS preferred)

- Knowledge of IoT concepts and data visualization is a plus

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail

- Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced, agile environment

Nice to Have

- Experience with AWS services (Lambda, IoT Core, DynamoDB, or similar)

- Background in game development or 3D modeling

- Familiarity with plant science, smart home, or environmental monitoring domains

- Experience with mobile UI/UX design principles

What We Offer

- Opportunity to work on an innovative project integrating AR, IoT, and cloud technologies

- Collaborative and supportive team environment

- Competitive salary and benefits package

- Career growth opportunities in emerging technologies

Work Location: In person

title: Solution Delivery Engineer
descriptionText:
You will own both pre-sales solution design and post-sale delivery for our Indonesia operation. You are the bridge between our China HQ and Indonesian customers (public / private / Chinese-medium universities + local Indonesian enterprise clients).

We are not looking for someone who already knows everything — we look for strong tri-lingual fluency, a solid CS foundation, and the drive to help us open up Southeast Asia as a brand-new frontier.

What You will DoPre-sales / Solution Design

* Visit Indonesian universities and enterprise clients with local Indonesian channel partners — understand their local AI education and vocational training needs
* Design Indonesia-localized solutions with remote support from our China HQ product team — adapt our standard product portfolio to Indonesian education and enterprise client-specific scenarios
* Prepare and deliver demos, POCs, and technical pitches in Bahasa Indonesia, English, or Chinese as needed for local stakeholders
* Support Indonesian local channel partners through bidding and pre-contract technical Q&A and local compliance reviews

Delivery / Implementation

* Lead client-side delivery across Indonesia: environment setup, product integration, Bahasa Indonesia content / UI localization, go-live and project acceptance
* Train Indonesian client faculty / students / enterprise employees on our products (in-person onsite + online remote sessions)
* First responder for local client technical issues; coordinate with China HQ for technical escalations and solution optimization
* Document Indonesian local case studies and standardized delivery playbooks — assets that fuel our future expansion to Thailand, Vietnam and other Southeast Asian markets

Cross-cultural Collaboration

* Collaborate with China HQ teams (product / engineering / commercial) in Mandarin Chinese — weekly sync meetings, requirement reviews, cross-border troubleshooting
* Engage with Indonesian customers and local partners professionally in Bahasa Indonesia and English
* Bridge cultural and operational gaps: translate not just language, but work rhythms and decision-making styles between Chinese and Indonesian business cultures

Who We Are Looking ForMust-Have

* *Tri-lingual Fluency* - Mandarin Chinese: written + spoken at working level. You can attend China HQ weekly meetings, write technical reports, and read product documentation in Chinese - Bahasa Indonesia: native level. You can hold formal business and technical conversations with local Indonesian clients and partners - English: business level. You can engage multinational enterprise clients and international business environments within Indonesia
* *Computer Science Background* - Bachelor's degree or above in CS, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or Information Technology - You understand operating systems, databases, and networks; you have actually written, run, and debugged real projects
* *2-4 Years Relevant Experience* - Pre-sales / Solution Architecture / Implementation / Training / IT pre-sales / Solutions Engineering — any of these directions - Background in education, SaaS, enterprise software, or IT integration is welcome
* *Hands-on Technical Capability* - Real experience in at least one of: Linux server deployment / API integration / SQL database operations / Python or other scripting languages - You can run demos, set up environments, read logs, and triage simple technical problems on your own

Nice to Have (assessed in interview)

* Higher education experience: prior projects with Indonesian universities, experience working with local academic departments
* Enterprise L&D experience: corporate training delivery, employee onboarding, TTT (Train-the-Trainer)
* Strong presentation skills: comfortable doing demos, technical pitches, 30+ minute professional talks
* Cross-cultural / travel readiness: willing to travel frequently across Indonesia for client visits, prior cross-border project experience
* AI hands-on: prior projects using LLMs, Agent frameworks, or RAG; unique insights on AI application in local Indonesian education scenarios
* Mission-driven: you believe education changes lives and want to make this your career, not just a job

Automatic Reject (Red Lines)

* Cannot work in Mandarin Chinese day-to-day (no matter how strong your Bahasa Indonesia or English)
* No formal CS academic background AND no equivalent self-taught project portfolio
* Treats this purely as a salary stepping stone, with zero interest in the education industry
* Lacks honest communication — habit of sugar-coating bad news

What We Offer

* Compensation: IDR 18,000,000 - 30,000,000 / month (negotiable based on experience; performance-based adjustments thereafter)
* Growth Path: As the founding engineer of our Indonesia operation, you grow with the business from 0 to 1. Within a year, opportunity to become Indonesia country lead or expand to other Southeast Asian markets
* Onboarding: 1-3 months in our Beijing HQ for product certification training and team integration
* Work Mode: Based in Indonesia (Jakarta or near major university and enterprise client clusters); frequent domestic travel to client sites across Indonesia
* Platform: Backed by our 60+ China HQ team (product / engineering / commercial); top local Indonesian network and education partners as long-term channel partners providing local on-site resources
* Values: Customer Success / Owner Mindset / Evidence-Based / Radical Candor / Shared Stake

Job Type: Full-time



Language:
* Mandarin Chinese (Required)

Work Location: Remote

title: Advanced Analysis Consultant
descriptionText:
About us

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

Position Summary
The FEA Engineer performs professional engineering work requiring sound knowledge of mechanical or structural engineering principles and proficiency in finite element simulation. The role involves developing, executing, and validating numerical models to assess structural and mechanical performance, applying engineering judgement to solve practical design and operational challenges.
The FEA Engineer will contribute to the delivery of technically complex projects, working under the guidance of senior consultants while progressively developing subject matter expertise in simulation-based engineer.

Overview
We are seeking a motivated FEA Engineer to join our Digital Solutions team. The role supports simulation-led design and engineering assessments across the Energy, Chemical, and Resources (ECR) sectors.
The successful candidate will apply advanced numerical analysis techniques using Finite Element Analysis (FEA) tools to support design verification, fitness-for-service (FFS) assessments, and structural integrity evaluations.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Execution:
• Develop finite element models for static, dynamic, and nonlinear analyses, applying appropriate meshing strategies, boundary conditions, and load representations.
• Conduct simulations using Abaqus, Ansys, or equivalent FEA software to support design and assessment activities.
• Perform checks on modelling accuracy, mesh sensitivity, convergence, and result interpretation.
• Apply relevant design codes, standards, and analytical methods to validate simulation outcomes.
• Support multidisciplinary engineering teams with numerical insights and recommendations for design optimisation and risk mitigation.
• Prepare detailed analysis reports, documenting assumptions, methodology, results, and engineering conclusions.

Project Delivery:
• Deliver assigned analysis tasks within agreed schedules, budgets, and quality requirements.
• Participate in technical reviews to ensure quality and consistency across simulation deliverables.
• Assist senior team members in managing project documentation, version control, and model traceability.

Business Support:
• Assist the Software and Simulation Business in Southeast Asia by providing technical expertise, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept studies that showcase the value of simulation tools in solving real engineering problems.
• Support pre-sales and post-sales technical activities, including benchmarking, workflow optimisation, and client training.
• Collaborate with the business development team to align technical capabilities with client needs and regional market initiatives.

Continuous Development:
• Maintain awareness of new developments in FEA methodologies, materials modelling, and computational practices.
• Contribute to workflow improvement through automation or scripting where applicable (e.g., Python, MATLAB).
• Support internal knowledge-sharing initiatives and contribute to the team’s technical database or modelling standards.

Health, Safety, and Quality:
• Ensure all analysis work complies with applicable health and safety requirements and internal quality management systems.
• Apply safe working practices in all assigned tasks and actively participate in safety initiatives.

Qualifications

A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical, Civil, Aerospace, or a related engineering discipline is required. A PhD will be considered a plus.
3–5 years of experience in engineering analysis using FEA tools.
Practical experience with Abaqus, ANSYS, or similar commercial FEA software.
Understanding of material nonlinearities, contact modelling, and structural dynamics.
Knowledge and experience of CFD will be an advantage.
Familiarity with relevant design codes and standards (e.g., ISO, AS, API, ASME, DNV).
Competency in Python or similar scripting languages for pre/post-processing is advantageous.
Strong technical writing and communication skills in English are essential. Proficiency in additional languages, such as Indonesian, Malay or Chinese or other regional languages, will be considered an asset.

Desired Attributes

Demonstrated ability to interpret engineering drawings and translate design intent into computational models.
Analytical and methodical approach to solving engineering problems.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to technical accuracy.
Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary environment.
Eagerness to learn advanced simulation techniques and expand domain expertise.

Moving forward together

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

This role provides a development pathway toward Senior or Principal Consultant positions within the Digital Solutions discipline. Exposure will include a wide range of simulation-based projects across design verification, integrity assessment, and digital engineering applications in the energy and resources sectors. This role provides a structured development pathway toward:
• Chartered Professional Engineer (CPEng) recognition.
• Subject Matter Expert in areas such as offshore engineering, structural integrity, or pressure equipment design and assessment.
• Digital Solutions Technologist with expertise in advanced simulation techniques and emerging digital technologies.

Progression will be supported through exposure to complex analysis projects, mentorship from senior consultants, and collaboration across simulation, engineering design, and digital consulting discipline.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Hydrology Staff
descriptionText:
Indoagri - PT. PP London Sumatra Tbk.

RO Palembang - Palembang

S1

Pengalaman - Tetap
Persyaratan Pekerjaan

Pendidikan S1 Teknik Sipil (Konsentrasi Sumber Daya Air), Teknik Lingkungan, Teknik Geologi, atau Teknik Pertambangan.
Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang pengelolaan sumber daya air atau tata kelola air.
Memahami konsep hidrologi, hidraulika, dan pengelolaan sumber daya air.
Mampu melakukan analisis dan interpretasi data meteorologi, hidrologi, serta statistik aliran sungai.
Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan problem solving yang baik.
Mahir mengoperasikan software pemodelan dan analisis hidrologi seperti HEC-RAS, HEC-HMS, dan SWAT.
Menguasai aplikasi AutoCAD dan Geographic Information System (GIS) seperti ArcGIS atau QGIS.
Terampil dalam pengolahan data dan penyusunan laporan teknis.
Memiliki sertifikasi yang relevan di bidang hidrologi, GIS, pengelolaan lingkungan, atau sumber daya air menjadi nilai tambah.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Melakukan analisis daerah aliran sungai (DAS), curah hujan, serta pemodelan hidrologi menggunakan perangkat lunak teknis untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
Merancang dan mengembangkan infrastruktur sumber daya air, termasuk sistem drainase, bendungan, kolam retensi, tanggul, dan jaringan irigasi.
Menyusun serta mengevaluasi analisis keseimbangan air (water balance) guna mendukung operasional perkebunan yang berkelanjutan dan ramah lingkungan.
Mengembangkan studi dan simulasi hidrologi untuk mengidentifikasi risiko banjir serta merumuskan strategi mitigasi yang efektif.
Memastikan seluruh kegiatan pengelolaan sumber daya air memenuhi regulasi pemerintah, standar lingkungan, dan ketentuan Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE).

Engineering

descriptionText:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.

Position SummaryWe are seeking a dedicated Facility Engineer to join our consulting team managing comprehensive facility operations for a major banking client across multiple branch locations throughout Indonesia. The successful candidate will oversee facility maintenance, compliance, and operational efficiency across our client's branch network, ensuring optimal working environments that support business operations and regulatory requirements.

He or She will be placed in Medan City.
Key ResponsibilitiesClient Relationship Management
Develop and maintain strong working relationships with branch managers and regional supervisors
Provide regular status updates and technical reports to client stakeholders
Multi-Site Facility Operations
Oversee facility management operations across multiple banking branches throughout Indonesia
Conduct regular site visits and inspections to assess facility conditions and operational needs
Coordinate preventive maintenance programs and emergency repair responses across branch network
Ensure consistent facility standards and operational procedures across all locations
Technical Systems Management
Monitor and maintain HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and security systems across branch locations
Oversee fire safety systems, emergency lighting, and life safety equipment compliance
Manage building automation systems and energy management initiatives
Coordinate with local vendors and contractors for specialized technical services
Compliance and Risk Management
Ensure all facilities comply with Indonesian building codes, safety regulations, and banking industry requirements
Maintain compliance with Bank Indonesia facility guidelines and security protocols
Conduct risk assessments and implement mitigation strategies for facility-related vulnerabilities
Manage documentation and reporting for regulatory audits and inspections
Project Management
Plan and execute facility improvement projects, renovations, and branch relocations
Manage project budgets, timelines, and resource allocation across multiple sites
Coordinate with design teams, contractors, and local authorities for construction permits and approvals
Oversee technology infrastructure installations and upgrades
Required QualificationsEducation and Certification
Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, or Civil) or related technical field
Professional engineering license or certification preferred
Facility Management Professional (FMP) certification advantageous
Experience
Minimum 5 years experience in facility management or engineering consulting
Previous experience managing multiple sites or branch networks preferred
Banking or financial services industry experience highly desirable
Proven track record in client-facing consulting roles
Technical Skills
Proficiency in facility management software and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS)
Strong knowledge of building systems including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire safety
Understanding of Indonesian building codes, safety regulations, and compliance requirements
Experience with energy management and sustainability initiatives
Language and Communication
Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English (written and verbal)
Excellent presentation and client communication skills
Strong technical writing abilities for reports and documentation
Preferred QualificationsExperience with banking security protocols and ATM facility requirements
Knowledge of Indonesian banking regulations and Bank Indonesia guidelines
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
Experience with green building standards and LEED certification processes
Familiarity with Indonesian labor laws and contractor management requirements
Key CompetenciesStrong analytical and problem-solving capabilities
Excellent organizational skills with ability to manage multiple priorities
Client service orientation with professional demeanor
Cultural sensitivity and ability to work effectively across diverse regional teams
Adaptability to travel requirements across Indonesia
Leadership skills to coordinate cross-functional teams and external vendors

Occasional weekend or after-hours work for emergency responses or project deadlines
Office-based work supplemented by extensive fieldwork at client locations
May require physical inspections of mechanical rooms, rooftops, and other facility areas
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. title: Coding Specialist (Fluent in Indonesian) - Freelance AI Trainer Project
descriptionText:
Are you a coding expert fluent in Indonesian eager to shape the future of AI? Large‑scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into powerful engines of scientific discovery. With high‑quality training data, tomorrow's AI can democratize world‑class education, keep pace with cutting‑edge research, and streamline software development for engineers everywhere. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI.

We're looking for coding specialists who live and breathe algorithms, data structures, software architecture, frontend and backend development, cloud infrastructure, and systems programming—and who can do so fluently in Indonesian. You'll challenge advanced language models on topics like asynchronous programming, RESTful API integration, memory management, object-oriented design, secure coding practices, and debugging distributed systems—documenting every failure mode so we can harden model reasoning.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on software engineering tasks and technical scenarios in Indonesian, verify logical accuracy and coding fluency, assess naturalness and correctness of Indonesian language usage, capture reproducible error traces, and suggest improvements to our prompt engineering and evaluation metrics.

A bachelor's or master's in computer science, software engineering, or a closely related technical field is ideal; real-world coding experience, technical writing in Indonesian, or open-source contributions signal fit. Clear, metacognitive communication—"showing your work"—is essential.

Ready to turn your coding and Indonesian language expertise into the knowledge base for tomorrow's AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $8‑to‑$65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you'll supply a secure computer and high‑speed internet; company‑sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

title: Business & Clinical Support Intern – Diagnostic Imaging.
descriptionText:
Do you want to contribute to the future of healthcare? As Siemens Healthineers values those who dedicate their energy and passion to this cause, our company’s name is dedicated to our employees. It’s their pioneering spirit, blended with our long history of engineering in the ever-evolving healthcare industry that truly makes us unique as an employer.

We offer you a flexible and dynamic environment and the space to stretch beyond your comfort zone in order to grow both personally and professionally. Sound interesting?

Then come join us, as a Business & Clinical Support Intern – Diagnostic Imaging.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

Assist in monitoring and managing sales-related data across multiple modalities, ensuring data accuracy, accessibility, and timely updates to support business reporting.
Support the existing team in daily coordination activities related to ongoing sales initiatives.
Collect and organize clinical images for use in product presentations and marketing materials.
Support the development of clinical pathway materials through proper clinical image documentation.
Ensure all patient data is anonymized in full compliance with privacy and regulatory standards.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, as well as Clinical Image Collection to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.

Your qualifications and experience:

Currently pursuing a degree in Biomedical engineering, Business Administration, Health Sciences, Medical Imaging, Data Management, or a related field (students from other disciplines are also welcome to apply).
Able to commit to a minimum 3-month part-time internship.
Previous internship experience in data management, healthcare, or administrative support is a plus.

Your attributes and skills:

You are proficient (spoken and written) in Bahasa Indonesia and English and possess good communication skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
Proficient in DICOM Viewer software for viewing, managing, and organizing clinical imaging data.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to handle and maintain data accuracy and confidentiality.
Understanding of or willingness to learn data privacy and regulatory compliance standards related to patient data.
Highly proactive, well-organized, and a strong problem solver when facing challenges.
Team player, able to manage multiple tasks, perform well under pressure, and contribute positively to team operations.

Our global team:

We are a team of 66,000 highly dedicated employees across more than 70 countries passionately pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in healthcare to help improve people’s lives around the world. As a leader in the industry, we aspire to create better outcomes and experiences for patients no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio, spanning from in-vitro and in-vivo diagnostics to image-guided therapy and innovative cancer care, is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

Our culture:

We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success.

To find out more about us, have a look at https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/en-id

title: Senior Java Engineer - Cloud Platform
descriptionText:
Denver, CO
Full Time
Engineering
Experienced
Job Title: Senior Java Engineer - Cloud Platform
Location: Denver, CO (Hybrid)

About FusionAuth

FusionAuth is a fast-growing startup and leading provider of customer identity and access management (CIAM) software headquartered in Denver, Colorado. Our mission is to make authentication and authorization simple and secure for every developer. Our product helps businesses securely manage customer identities and access, ensuring a seamless and safe user experience for some of the largest brands in the world. We are committed to delivering exceptional value and satisfaction to our clients through top-notch service and support. With a great team and strong investors, we are expanding our team to help accelerate our growth and take FusionAuth to the next level.

Job Summary

We are recruiting a Senior Software Engineer who will join our engineering team to help us achieve these goals. This exciting role will allow you to build new features and extend and influence our existing product offering. While you'll be expected to contribute in all areas of the product, this role will have a strong emphasis on working on the FusionAuth cloud platform. For this role, you must be a creative and quantitative thinker. You should be interested in the authentication, authorization and user management space. You should be seasoned at writing secure and high-performance code. The ideal candidate will be a self-starter, fast worker and excited about growing a company from the ground up. This position reports to the Head of our Platform Engineering Team.

Responsibilities

Writing high-quality, performant, and secure Java code
Connect unfamiliar technical concepts to your existing knowledge base and find pragmatic paths forward
Balance immediate deliverables with long-term architectural thinking and planning
Writing extensive and thorough tests
Extending our cloud offering with security, scalability, and control plane features
Helping to maintain and extend the FusionAuth Terraform provider
Supporting other engineers with your cloud and platform expertise
Writing clear, high-quality documentation for new features
Participating in the on-call engineer rotation, solving critical customer issues should they arise. While not the norm, we do have some off-hours support requirements.
Provide technical support to our customers
Be a voice of positive change in the Engineering organization

Qualifications

Required

10+ years of professional software development experience
6+ years of experience with a heavy ops or platform engineering component
Highly proficient in the Java programming language and object-oriented design and implementation
Deep, hands-on experience with AWS
Strong platform engineering experience in a Linux environment
Experience architecting, building, and managing complex application topologies on Kubernetes
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools, particularly Terraform
Experience with designing and building high-availability, highly-performant applications
Comfortable using AI tools in your development workflow
Located in the Denver metropolitan area with the ability to come into our Westminster office 2-3 times per week

Preferred

Experience up and down the entire stack, including cloud infrastructure, operating systems, databases, back-end and front-end services
Experience with Golang development
Real working knowledge of relational databases — you understand query optimization, indexing strategies, and database design beyond ORM abstractions
Passion for security in general, and auth specifically
Quick learner with the ability to rapidly master new technologies and skills
Influential communicator: holds strong opinions but adapts flexibly to new information or team input
Appreciates first principles thinking, but understands when it's time to stop theorizing and start building
Adaptable to challenges common in a startup with ~60 employees and thrives in a dynamic startup vibe

Compensation

$170k–$200k expected base salary range*

*Pursuant to various state laws, we must display the pay range for this job. Since we are willing to hire within a broad spectrum of qualifications, this range is broad. The expected base salary may be adjusted based on individual qualifications, role, level and location.

Onsite Perks & Campus Benefits

When you join FusionAuth’s Denver team, you’ll enjoy a modern campus experience designed for productivity, wellness, and community:

Newly upgraded amenity spaces including a sleek tenant lounge and café with booth seating and collaborative workspaces.
Access to a fitness studio, showers, lockers, and secure bike storage.
Regularly stocked in-suite kitchen with a variety of snacks and beverages to keep you fueled throughout the day.
Onsite café offering chef-driven menus with fresh, locally sourced, organic, and non-GMO options to suit diverse dietary needs. Easy ordering via app.
3-acres of green space, including communal parks and picnic areas, connected to miles of jogging, biking, and recreation trails.
Yoga in the circle and wellness programs to enhance work-life balance.
Dedicated outdoor workspaces and patio gathering areas.
Ample on-site parking, easy freeway access, and high-speed fiber internet.
Sustainability-minded campus and community initiatives, including support for regenerative agriculture programs.

Enjoy a high-tech business environment that inspires creativity and energizes your workday—all just minutes from the heart of Denver and Boulder.

Benefits

For full-time team members, we offer:

Comprehensive health insurance including medical, dental, and vision coverage, with the company covering the majority of your medical premiums to keep your costs low
Fully employer-paid High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) option paired with a Health Savings Account (HSA), including employer contributions
Basic life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage fully paid by the company for essential financial protection
Voluntary life insurance options to provide additional financial protection for you and your loved ones
Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs) to save pre-tax dollars on eligible expenses
401(k) plan with company match to help you save for retirement
Generous paid time off (PTO) plus paid company holidays to support work-life balance
Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering confidential counseling and support services
Professional growth and development opportunities to boost your career journey
Eligibility for performance-based bonuses or variable compensation tied to individual, team, or company results

Important Details

Application Submission: We value authentic, thoughtful responses. Copy/pasted or AI-generated answers to application questions that don’t reflect your own experience may disqualify your application.
In-Person Interview: Please be aware that participating in an in-person interview is encouraged so we can get to know each other. FusionAuth reimburses reasonable travel and lodging expenses associated with onsite interviews.
Work Authorization: Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

If you are passionate about technology that solves real-world customer problems, and want to join a company that is moving the industry forward, FusionAuth is a perfect fit for you!

Equal Employment Opportunity
FusionAuth provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

Recruiters
FusionAuth does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed agreement, we reserve the right to pursue and hire candidates without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. descriptionText:

Job Category: Infrastructure

Location: Jakarta, JK, Indonesia

Join a company that is passionately committed to the pursuit of a better world through positive change. With more than 70 years of business and technical expertise in mining, energy, and infrastructure, our 10,000 colleagues in 150 countries tirelessly work toward bettering the industries in which we operate. With practical solutions that are safe, innovative and sustainable, we think globally while acting locally. Are you looking for an opportunity to join a diverse group of professionals who are committed to remaining exceptional? We look forward to hearing from you.

Our expertise in infrastructure includes aviation, highways and bridges, planning and advisory services, ports, rail and transit, tunnels, and water. Want to be part of the creation and construction of our cities? Then the infrastructure team is for you!

Our Infrastructure team is growing, fuelled by project wins and future expansion. We’re seeking a passionate Structural Bridge Engineer to join our team and play a key role in shaping major infrastructure outcomes. If you have proven experience in the infrastructure sector and are eager to elevate your career, this is a fantastic opportunity to do meaningful work that makes an impact. You’ll collaborate on a diverse range of projects for well‑known, reputable clients giving you exposure, challenge, and the chance to truly grow your expertise.

With our business entering an exciting phase of expansion, you’ll be empowered to accelerate your career, broaden your technical capabilities, and contribute to the growth of both our practice and the wider Hatch communities of practice. This is your opportunity to be part of something dynamic, influential, and future‑focused.

Key Responsibilities of this role include:

Playing a key role in driving the engineering commitments process to ensure alignment with scope, schedule, budget, and procedures for successful project completion
Provide Structural engineering analysis and design for varied public and heavy industrial structures and associated foundations for steel and concrete in accordance to applicable standards
Prepare, reviewing and checking engineering calculations, technical specifications and scopes of work
Prepare Material Take Offs/Bill of quantities
Review and check engineering drawings
Provide input to engineering, operating and cost estimates
Providing input into design reviews and contributing to the design lifecycle from tender and feasibility through to detailed design execution
Client/Stakeholder management

descriptionText:
*Sales and Business Development Manager*

*Company:* Quantum Realm Engineering

*Compensation:* Base salary plus commission or success bonus to be confirmed

*Industry:* IT, software development, AI and digital products

*Work format:* Remote

*Employment type:* Full-time

*English level:* Advanced

*Key Skills*

* Prospecting

* Long sales cycles

* Email outreach

* Lead qualification

* Digital product sales
* Communication
* Negotiation

*Job Description*

Quantum Realm Engineering is looking for a Sales and Business Development Manager to help source, qualify and close new client opportunities across software development, AI, websites, apps and digital product services.

We are an Australian software, AI and digital product company working with clients across different industries. Our team includes developers, designers, QA engineers, project managers, content specialists and technical leads.

A major part of this role is finding suitable companies online that may need help with their website, brand, app, internal systems, dashboards, client portals or digital workflows.

This is not a purely inbound sales role. You will be expected to research possible clients, identify decision-makers, start conversations and build relationships through LinkedIn, email, calls and other direct outreach methods.

The right person should be comfortable with sourcing new opportunities, but the sale itself is not short-term or transactional. We are looking for someone who can build trust, understand business problems and manage longer sales cycles for higher-value digital projects.

*Role Focus*

This role is focused on finding and selling opportunities such as:

* Website redesigns and website rebuilds
* Brand refresh projects
* App rebuilds or app improvements
* New web apps and mobile apps
* AI agents and AI-powered systems
* Internal dashboards and reporting tools
* Client portals and online profiles
* Business automation
* Custom software development
* Digital product design
* Technical support for growing companies
* Media, content and marketing support where relevant to the project

*Key Responsibilities*

The successful candidate will be responsible for sourcing new opportunities, starting conversations and helping move suitable leads towards signed projects.

*Client Sourcing*

Find companies online that may need a better website, app, brand presence, internal system, dashboard, client portal or digital product.

Research their current online presence and identify where Quantum Realm Engineering may be able to help.

*Prospect Research*

Build lists of suitable companies, founders, business owners, operators and decision-makers.

Identify the right person to contact and understand the likely business reason for reaching out.

*Outreach*

Start conversations through LinkedIn, email, phone calls and other direct outreach methods.

Write clear, personal and relevant messages that connect the prospect’s current business need to the services Quantum Realm Engineering can provide.

*Lead Qualification*

Qualify leads based on business need, budget, urgency, decision process and fit.

Separate serious opportunities from low-value or poor-fit enquiries.

*Sales Conversations*

Run or support discovery calls with potential clients.

Ask clear questions about what they need, what is currently not working and what commercial outcome they want from the project.

*Proposal Support*

Work with the internal team to prepare proposals, project outlines and follow-up material.

Make sure proposals are based on the client’s actual business problem, budget level and buying process.

*Pipeline Management*

Track leads, outreach, follow-ups, call notes, next steps and deal status clearly inside the CRM.

Keep the team updated on likely deal value, timing and closing risks.

*Follow-Up and Closing*

Manage follow-ups in a professional way.

Move suitable opportunities towards agreement, contract and project kick-off without overpromising.

*Client Handover*

Support a clean handover from sales to delivery.

Make sure the project team understands the client’s goals, expectations and key requirements.

*Required Experience and Skills*

The ideal candidate should have:

* At least 2+ years of experience in B2B sales, business development or account management
* Experience sourcing new clients online
* Experience with LinkedIn outreach, email outreach and phone-based follow-up
* Experience selling higher-value services, software, technology or digital projects
* Strong understanding of long sales cycles
* Strong written and spoken English
* Confidence speaking with founders, executives and senior decision-makers
* Ability to research companies and identify where they may need digital support
* Ability to qualify leads properly and avoid wasting time on poor-fit opportunities
* Strong follow-up habits
* Experience using a CRM
* Ability to understand business problems and explain technical services in plain language
* Good commercial judgement
* Strong documentation habits
* Ability to work with technical, design and project teams
* A direct and professional communication style

*Apply If You Are*

* Strong at finding potential clients online
* Comfortable reaching out to people you have not spoken to before
* Good at writing clear LinkedIn and email messages
* Confident enough to call potential clients when needed
* Good at building trust with business owners and decision-makers
* Comfortable with longer sales cycles
* Strong at asking the right questions
* Able to qualify serious buyers from casual enquiries
* Commercially minded
* Organised with follow-ups and CRM updates
* Comfortable selling software, AI and digital product services
* Able to work with technical teams without overpromising
* Clear, direct and professional in written communication

*This Role Is Not For You If*

* You do not want to source new clients
* You only want to manage inbound leads
* You are not comfortable with LinkedIn, email or phone outreach
* You only want short, transactional sales
* You prefer low-value, high-volume selling
* You are uncomfortable with technical services
* You struggle with follow-up and CRM discipline
* You overpromise to close deals
* You do not like longer decision cycles

*Additional Experience That Would Be a Plus*

* Experience selling software development services
* Experience selling AI, automation or technical consulting
* Experience finding companies that need website, brand, app or system improvements
* Experience working with start-ups, founders or small to medium businesses
* Experience preparing proposals or pitch material
* Experience with HubSpot, Pipedrive or similar CRM tools
* Knowledge of websites, apps, SaaS products, dashboards, portals or digital marketing
* Existing business network in Australia, the United Kingdom, South Africa or Europe

*Benefits*

* Remote work
* Flexible working hours
* Work with an Australian software and AI company
* Opportunity to sell higher-value projects rather than low-value one-off work
* Work across AI, apps, websites, automation and digital product projects
* Direct access to the delivery team
* Room to grow into a senior business development role

* Bali (Preferred)

This role supports the day-to-day operations and execution of campaign delivery across digital and communication channels.
